blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We ask whether Jev, a typed classifier that returns probabilities over permitted answers without generating text, can replace an LLM rubric judge. We compare it with three flash-tier LLM judges on nine panels drawn from seven benchmarks, giving every judge identical criterion texts. Jev’s accuracy differs significantly from an LLM judge’s in only 8 of 27 paired comparisons, ahead mostly on binary criteria and behind only on graded ones, and most of the other comparisons are inconclusive. Summed over the nine panels, the LLM judges, called once per criterion, cost 29 to 325 times as much as Jev and took 30 to 220 times as long. On graded criteria all four judges agree more with one another than with the labels and mostly assign lower levels than the raters. One of several observational accounts is that raters followed scale conventions our criterion texts omit. Jev’s confidence ranks its own errors on most panels, which should make a cheap classifier the ideal first stage of a cascade that defers its uncertain verdicts to an LLM judge. Correlated errors undo that advantage. The LLM judges repeat nearly all of Jev’s most confident errors, so a cascade replayed on the recorded verdicts lowers cost but gains at most 1.5 points over the best single judge with cross-fitted thresholds, and at most 2.0 even with oracle thresholds.
blocks.zh: 我们问Jev,一个输入的分类器,在不生成文本的情况下,在允许的答案上返回概率,它是否能够替换一个LLM值判断器。 我们把它与从7个基准中抽取的9个分庭的3名简易LLM法官进行比较,使每位法官的标准文本都相同。 Jev的准确性与LLM法官的精确性大不相同,在27个对称比较中只有8个,在二进制标准上居前,在分级标准上居后,其他比较大多没有定论。 合计到9个小组,即LLM法官,每标准召集一次,费用为Jev的29至325倍,耗时30至220倍。 在分级标准方面,所有四名法官彼此同意的都多于标签,而且大多分配的级别低于评分。 几个观察的叙述之一是,评分者遵循我们的标准文本省略的尺度惯例。 Jev的信心将自己的错误排在大多数板块上,这应该让廉价的分类员成为级联的理想第一阶段,将不确定的判决交由LLM法官作出。 相关错误抵消了这一优势。 LLM评委几乎重复了Jev所有最自信的错误,因此在记录的判决上重播的级联会降低成本,但收益最高为1.5分,高于最佳单一评委的跨尺寸阈值,最多为2.0分,甚至有甲骨文阈值。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rubric-based evaluation turns a judgment about an output into verdicts on individual criteria, for instance whether a chemistry answer states a required relation or which of five levels an essay reaches on grammar. We call the judged submission a unit and a (unit, criterion) combination a pair . LLM judges produce these verdicts for benchmarks such as HealthBench ( Arora et al., 2025 ) and as rewards for reinforcement learning ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) , and they are validated against human labels ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Bavaresco et al., 2025 ) . A per-criterion grader such as AutoRubric’s makes one LLM call per pair ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , so an evaluation’s cost grows with units times criteria.
blocks.zh: 基于Rubric的评价把对产出的判断变成对个别标准的判决,例如,化学答案是说明一种必要的关系,还是五级论文中哪一级涉及语法。 我们称判断呈文为单位,(单位,标准)组合为一对. LLM法官为诸如Health Bench(Arora等人,2025年)等基准和作为强化学习的奖励(Gunjal等人,2026年)做出这些判决,并对照人类标签加以验证(Zheng等人,2023年;Bavaresco等人,2025年)。 类似AutoRubric的每个标准分级器每对(Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026年)会发出一个LLM调用, 所以一个评价的成本随着单位乘以标准而增加。

blocks.en: We use typed classifier for a model that answers a question about a structured input with a probability distribution over a fixed set of permitted answers, without producing free text. Jev, from TypeSafe, 1 1 1 Vendor documentation: https://docs.typesafe.ai , accessed 23 September 2026. is one such model. It is billed per input token, and one request carries every criterion of a unit, so the unit’s text is billed once. Jev also returns a probability or a confidence with each answer, so it could either replace an LLM judge or decide which pairs need one.
blocks.zh: 我们使用打入的分类器来进行一个模型,这个模型回答关于结构化输入的问题,概率分布在固定的一组允许的答案上,而不产生免费的文本. Jev,来自TypeSafe,11 1 供应商文件:https://docs.typesafe.ai,访问2026年9月23日。 它每个输入符都收费,一个请求包含一个单位的每个标准,因此该单位的文本只收费一次. Jev还用每个答案返回一个概率或置信度,因此它可以替换一个LLM判断器,或者决定哪些对需要一个.

blocks.en: We ask whether Jev can stand in for an LLM rubric judge and, where no judge reproduces the human raters, whether the shortfall belongs to one judge or to all of them, and what it traces to.
blocks.zh: 我们问,Jev是否可以支持一个LLM卢布法官,如果没有法官重复人的评分,那么缺额是属于一名法官,还是全部法官,以及它所记录的是什么。

blocks.en: We compare Jev with three flash-tier LLM judges, low-priced models from three vendors: GPT-5.6 Luna, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (Luna, Gemini, and DeepSeek from here on). All four receive the same 5,003 pairs from nine panels , fixed samples of seven public benchmarks paired with rubrics (Table 1 ). Two panels, the binary panels , have only binary criteria, and the other seven, the graded panels , grade most criteria on ordered levels. Every judge reads the same criterion texts, from rubric versions that we wrote before this study, with no examples, rewording, or tuning (Section 3.3 ). We formed our expectations about Jev on the binary panels and tested them on the graded ones, and our account of the judges’ shortfall (Section 5 ) came afterwards and is exploratory.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了Jev与三个闪光级LLM评委,来自三个卖家的低价模型:GPT-5.6 Luna,双子座3.8 Flash,以及DeepSeek V4.1 Flash(Luna,双子座和DeepSeek从这里开始). 所有四个国家都从9个面板得到同样的5 003对,7个公共基准的固定样本与数字对齐(表1)。 有两个面板,二进制面板,只有二进制标准,其他七个面板,分级面板,分级在命令级别上的大多数标准. 每个法官都从我们在本研究之前撰写的标语版本读出同样的标准文本,没有实例、重新措辞或调音(第3.3节)。 我们对Jev在二进制小组中的期望形成,

blocks.en: In accuracy, Jev is seldom distinguishable from the LLM judges. Only 8 of its 27 comparisons with an LLM judge on a panel have a 95% interval of the difference that excludes zero (Figure 1 ). Jev’s leads among them fall mostly on the binary panels and its deficits only on graded panels, chiefly against Gemini, usually the best LLM judge. Most of the others are too imprecise to show the judges equivalent (Section 4.1 ). Over the nine panels Gemini’s bill was 325 times Jev’s, and its run took 33 times as long (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在准确性方面,Jev很少能与LLM法官区分开来. 其27个比较中,只有8个与一个专门小组的LLM法官有95%的差额,不包括0(图1)。 Jev的领先优势主要落在二进制板上, 其他法官大多过于不准确,无法显示相应的法官(第4.1节)。 在9个小组中,双子座的法案是Jev的325倍,其运行时间为33倍(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: On every graded panel the four judges’ agreement with one another exceeds their agreement with the human labels, and on six of the seven every judge’s mean level lies below the labels’ mean, by about a level on ELLIPSE’s learner essays. Their shortfall against the raters is concentrated in a minority of criteria and comes more from where a judge places units on the scale than from how it orders them. A post-hoc shift of each judge’s levels on a criterion by a constant removes most of it (Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 每个分级的评委中,四位法官之间的协议超越了他们对人类标签的协议,在七位法官中,六位法官的平均级别低于评委的平均值,大约是ELLIPSE的学习者论文的一级。 他们对评分员的不足集中在少数标准上,更多地来自法官将单位放在比例上的地方,而不是它如何命令单位。 每名法官的级别在标准上按常数变动后,将取消大部分标准(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: One account is that the labels encode conventions that a judge reading only the criterion text never receives, such as judging a level relative to the population that the raters were trained to rate ( Weigle, 1994 ; Glaser, 1963 ) . On one criterion text shared by two dialogue corpora, the judges’ levels fall well below the labels on one corpus and near them on the other (Section 5.4 ). Priors shared through training data, or a common reluctance to grant top levels, could produce the same pattern, and on ELLIPSE our criterion sentence calls the top level “native-like facility”, which alone could lower the judges’ levels. The raters also worked from each benchmark’s own instructions, which may state what our rubric versions omit. No experiment varied the text, so the account is observational.
blocks.zh: 一种说法是,法官只读标准文本从未收到的标签编码惯例,例如判断与人口相对的等级,评分者受过评分训练(Weigle,1994年;Glaser,1963年)。 在两个对话公司共同使用的一个标准文本中,法官的级别远远低于一个实体的标签,接近另一个实体的标签(第5.4节)。 通过培训数据共享的先例,或普遍不愿授予最高一级,可以产生同样的模式,在ELLIPSE上,我们的标准句子将最高一级称为 " 类似本地的设施 " ,仅此就可以降低法官的级别。 评分者也根据每个基准本身的指示工作,这些指示可能说明我们的标题版本省略了什么。 没有实验会更改文字,所以这个帐户是观察性的.

blocks.en: Jev’s confidence suggests a cascade that keeps its confident verdicts and pays an LLM judge for the rest, since on most panels its less confident verdicts err more often (Section 6.1 ). Such a cascade can beat the LLM judge only on kept pairs where Jev is right and that judge is wrong. These pairs are few because the judges make correlated errors : when one judge is wrong, another gives the same wrong verdict more often than independent errors would. The pairs on which the judges are wrong together are the “same places” of our title, and Jev’s errors are repeated most often where it is most confident. On its most confident errors, 96.0% of the LLM judges’ verdicts repeat its wrong answer, against about half under independence (Section 6.2 ). Replayed post hoc with thresholds chosen on half of the units and scored on the rest, a cascade that falls back on the best LLM judge nearly matches that judge at under half its cost on most panels. Even so, no cascade’s average gain over the best single judge of its panel, Jev’s own framings included, exceeds 1.5 points (Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh: Jev的信心表明,一个级联可以保持其信心,并支付LLM法官的其余费用,因为在大多数小组中,其不太自信的判决往往是错误的(第6.1节)。 这样的级联只能击败LLM法官 在Jev是对的 和那个法官错了 这些对子很少,因为法官会犯相关错误:当一名法官出错时,另一名法官会比独立错误更经常做出同样的错误判决。 法官们共同犯错的对联是我们头衔的 " 同一地方 " ,而Jev的错误经常在最有信心的地方重复。 在最有信心的错误中,96.0%的LLM法官的裁决重复了错误的答案,而独立时只有一半(第6.2节)。 重播后特别节目,在一半单元上选择门槛值,其余部分则得分,这一级联在最佳LLM评委上倒下,几乎与该评委在大多数评委小组上的成本不足一半。 即使如此,任何级联的平均收益都不会超过其评委小组的最佳单一法官,包括Jev自己的框架,超过1.5分(第6.3节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Zheng et al. (2023) catalogued position, verbosity, and self-enhancement biases in LLM judges and found GPT-4 agreeing with human preferences about as often as humans agree with each other, and Chiang and Lee (2023) found LLM ratings consistent with expert ratings when the LLMs received the human evaluators’ instructions. JUDGE-BENCH ( Bavaresco et al., 2025 ) , which includes both USR sets used here and scores graded annotations by correlation, found that reliability varies with the property evaluated and the annotators’ expertise. High percent agreement can hide large differences between judge and human scores ( Thakur et al., 2025 ) , and uncertain human labels can make a machine look as good as a second human ( Elangovan et al., 2025 ) . We therefore report the offset (Section 3.5 ) beside agreement. Because disagreement among raters can be signal as well as noise ( Plank, 2022 ) , we also report unanimous and split pairs separately.
blocks.zh: Zheng等人(2023年)在LLM评委中被编目位置,动词和自我增强偏颇,并发现GPT-4同意人类的偏好,和人类相互认同一样频繁,蒋和李(2023年)在LLM收到人类评价师指示时发现LLM评委的评分与专家评分一致. JUDGE-BENCH(Bavaresco等人,2025年),它既包括此处使用的USR套装,也包括按相关性分级的说明,它发现可靠性因评价的财产和注释员的专长而异。 高百分比协议可以掩盖判断和人类得分之间的巨大差异(Thakur等人,2025年),不确定的人类标签可以让机器看起来和第二人一样好(Elangovan等人,2025年). 因此,我们报告除协议外的抵消(第3.5节)。 由于评分者之间的分歧既可以是信号也可以是噪声(Plank, 2022),

blocks.en: Prometheus and Prometheus 2 train open evaluators to score text against user-supplied rubrics ( Kim et al., 2024a ; Kim et al., 2024b ) . CheckEval replaces Likert scoring with binary checklist questions and raises agreement ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , and HealthBench refined its consensus criteria until their intent was clear to its grader ( Arora et al., 2025 ) . LLM-Rubric answers each rubric question as a distribution over its options and trains a small network that maps those distributions to each human judge’s labels ( Hashemi et al., 2024 ) . Such a layer would absorb a systematic error like the offset we measure, which is why we fit none on top of any judge.
blocks.zh: Prometheus和Prometheus 2培训了开放式评价员,以对照用户提供的数值对文字进行评分(Kim等人,2024a); Kim等人, 2024b) (中文(简体) ). 检查 Eval 替换 Likrt用二进制核对表问题评分,并引起一致意见(Lee等人,2025年),Health Bench完善了共识标准,直到其意图对分级者明确为止(Arora等人,2025年)。 LLM-Rubric回答每个主题的问题, 这种层层将吸收一个系统性错误,就像我们衡量的抵消,这就是为什么我们没有任何法官。

blocks.en: Prior automatic evaluation on the dialogue sets reports correlations with the rater mean. FED and USR introduced reference-free metrics there ( Mehri and Eskenazi, 2020a ; Mehri and Eskenazi, 2020b ) , and G-Eval and LLM-Eval report LLM evaluators ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Lin and Chen, 2023 ) . On ELLIPSE, supervised models reach a mean quadratic-weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.854 on the six analytic traits ( Aljuaid et al., 2025 ) , and zero-shot GPT-4 reaches 0.307 on the holistic score ( Hou et al., 2025 ) , a different target. Essay graders built on LLMs assign lower scores than human raters ( Kundu and Barbosa, 2024 ) and penalize minor errors that humans discount ( Mathew et al., 2026 ) , and in our data Jev also places ELLIPSE essays below the raters (Section 5.3 ). Calibration examples help GPT-4 rate short second-language essays ( Yancey et al., 2023 ) . Because a correlation with the rater mean does not register a constant shift, we also report exact accuracy and the offset, for four judges under one protocol.
blocks.zh: 对对话进行事先的自动评价将报告与评分平均值联系起来。 FED和USR在那里引入了无参考度量衡(Mehri和Eskenazi,2020a;Mehri和Eskenazi,2020b),以及G-Eval和LLM-Eval报告LLM评价员(Liu等人,2023;Lin和Chen,2023). 在ELLIPSE上,受监督的型号在六个分析特征上达到0.854的中四加权卡帕(QWK),零镜头的GPT-4在整体分数上达到0.307(Hou等人,2025年),是一个不同的目标. 以LLMS为基础的Essay分数比人类分数低(Kundu和Barbosa, 2024年), Jev还将ELLIPSE的散文置于评分以下(第5.3节)。 校准实例有助于GPT-4对短篇第二语言散文进行校准(Yancey等人,2023年). 由于与评分器的关联意味着没有恒定变化,我们还报告根据一项协议对四名法官进行精确准确和抵消。

blocks.en: Across more than 350 models, larger and more accurate models make highly correlated errors even across providers ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and mistakes grow more similar as capability increases ( Goel et al., 2025 ) . We measure how often LLM judges repeat a typed classifier’s errors, against a baseline that fixes the criterion and the label (Section 6.2 ). A jury of smaller judges from different families can still reduce the bias of a single large judge ( Verga et al., 2024 ) . Probabilities over a closed option set can carry information about correctness ( Guo et al., 2017 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ) , which selective prediction uses to abstain ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) and cascades use to escalate from cheap to expensive models ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Trust or Escalate ( Jung et al., 2025 ) escalates between judges with a threshold set on a calibration set and a guarantee of human agreement, whereas we replay cascades from recorded verdicts with oracle and with cross-fitted thresholds (both defined in Section 6.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在350多个模型中,更大和更准确的模型甚至在供应商之间也产生高度相关的错误(Kim等人,2025年),而且随着能力的提高,错误也变得更加相似(Goel等人,2025年)。 我们对照一个确定标准和标签的基线(第6.2节),衡量LLM法官重复打字员错误的频率。 由来自不同家庭的较小法官组成的陪审团仍然可以减少单一大法官的偏见(Verga等人,2024年). 关闭选项集的概率可以携带关于正确性的信息(Guo等人,2017年;Kadavath等人,2022年),选择性预测用于弃权(Geifman和El-Yaniv,2017年),级联用于从廉价模型升级到昂贵模型(Chen等人,2024年). 信任或Escalate(Jung等人,2025年)在法官之间升级,在一套标准上设定了门槛,并保障了人类同意,而我们则用甲骨文和跨度阈值(两者都在第6.3节中界定)从记录的判决中重现级联。

blocks.en: 3 Judges, Panels, and Protocol
blocks.zh: 3名法官、小组和礼宾

blocks.en: All judges run inside AutoRubric’s open-source criterion grader ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , which we call the harness . Of the nine panels (Table 1 ), RiceChem and HealthBench are the binary panels. The options of a graded criterion are ordered levels, and four of the seven graded panels also include binary criteria.
blocks.zh: AutoRubric的开源标准分级器(Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026年)中, 在9个面板(表1)中,RiceChem和Health Bench是二进制面板. 分级标准的选择是定级,七个分级板中的四个还包括二进制标准.

blocks.en: 3.1 Jev
blocks.zh: 3.1 捷夫语

blocks.en: The vendor calls Jev a “System One” model and prices it at $0.042 per million input tokens, with output tokens free. Requests named the jev-latest alias, which a stability check run on the same day logged as jev-1.13.0 (the main runs did not log the version; Appendix A ). Besides one question per criterion of the unit, a request carries a structured record, which the vendor calls a state. The record holds the unit’s input (a prompt, conversation, or question) and the submission, the same two fields the harness passes to an LLM judge. Jev never sees the harness’s system prompt, and it always sees options in scale order. No judge sees an option’s value , the number from 0 to 1 that the harness attaches to each level.
blocks.zh: 供应商称Jev为“系统一”模式,价格为每百万美元输入令牌0.042美元,产出令牌免费。 要求将jev-latest别名命名为jev-1.13.0, 当天记录的稳定性检查为jev-1.13.0(主运行没有记录该版本;附录A)。 除每个单元的标准都有一个问题外,请求还附有结构化记录,供应商称之为状态。 记录载有该单位的投入(即时、对话或提问)和呈文,同样是吊带传递给LLM法官的两个字段。 Jev从来不会看到绳索的系统迅速, 任何法官都看不出一个选项的价值,

blocks.en: Jev answers through three primitives , each read with its own decoding rule . Noul returns the probability that the answer is yes, which we threshold at 0.5. blocks.en: 3.2 The LLM judges
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 LLM法官

blocks.en: Each LLM judge runs through the harness with its default system prompts, one call per pair. DeepSeek is reached through OpenRouter (Appendix A ). The harness shuffles the options on every call with a logged seed to counter position bias ( Wang et al., 2024a ) . Temperature is 0 except for Luna, whose API accepts only its default of 1.0. Reasoning effort is left at provider defaults, and all three judges emitted reasoning tokens, Luna far fewer than the other two (Appendix A ). The multi-choice system prompt asks the judge to attend to negation, scope, and qualifying language and not to retreat to a middle option when unsure. When a submission contradicts itself and no stance dominates on an ordered scale, it asks for the lower-quality level. Table A2 gives the model identifiers (none names a dated snapshot) and every other difference between the judges’ inputs.
blocks.zh: 每个LLM判官都会用它的默认系统提示符,每对1个呼叫符,通过控制带运行. DeepSeek通过OpenRouter(Appendix A.)实现. 在每一次通话中, 温度为0,但Luna除外,其API只接受它的默认为1.0. 提供商违约时会做出合理努力,所有三名法官都发出推理信使,Luna远远少于其他两名(附录A)。 多选择制度促使法官注意否定、范围和限定语言,在不确定时不要退到中间选择。 当呈文自相矛盾,且没有立场在有序的尺度上占据主导地位时,它会要求质量较低的级别. 表A2列出模型识别符(无名称为日期快照)和法官投入的所有其他差异。

blocks.en: 3.3 Panels
blocks.zh: 3.3 小组

blocks.en: FED supplies two panels, FED-Turn and FED-Dialogue, and USR supplies USR-TC and USR-PC, whose conversations come from Topical-Chat ( Gopalakrishnan et al., 2019 ) and PersonaChat ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . LFQA’s questions and human answers come from ELI5 ( Fan et al., 2019 ) . ELLIPSE calls its criteria traits, and HelpSteer2 calls them attributes. The graded panels hold 3,778 of each matched judge’s 5,003 pairs.
blocks.zh: FED提供FED-Turn和FED-对话两个面板,USR提供USR-TC和USR-PC,他们的谈话来自Topical-Chat(Gopalakrishnan等人,2019年)和Persona 查特(张等,2018年). LFQA的问答来自ELI5(Fan等人,2019年). ELLIPSE称其标准特征,帮助Steer2称其属性. 分级的评委每名匹配的法官的5 003对中有3 778对。

blocks.en: Each graded panel is a 10% or 20% sample of units, stratified where the source allows and drawn with a fixed seed before any judge call (Table A1 ). The RiceChem panel is the 10% test split of each question’s responses (an 80/10/10 split with seed 42). The HealthBench panel holds 200 completions from 196 conversations and 406 pairs. Its 34 criteria are consensus criteria, the physician-validated subset of HealthBench’s criteria, and they use 30 distinct texts because some share a text across themes.
blocks.zh: 每个分级的面板是10%或20%的单元样本,在来源允许的情况下进行分级,并在任何裁判呼叫前用固定种子绘制(表A1)。 RiceChem的面板是每个问题回答的10%的测试分数(80/10/10分与种子42分). 健康奔驰小组从196次谈话和406对谈话中共进行了200次完成. 它的34条标准是协商一致的标准,是医生认证的Health Bench标准子集,它们使用30条不同的文本,因为有些人分享一个跨主题的文本。

blocks.en: The criterion sentences and level descriptions of the graded panels come from rubric versions of each benchmark that we wrote for a separate, unpublished study of criterion aggregation and fixed before any judge in this study was run. They recast the FED and USR questions as statements, paraphrase HelpSteer2’s level wording, and take LFQA’s level descriptions from the rating prompt that the benchmark’s authors wrote for GPT-4. For ELLIPSE they keep the level descriptions of the corpus’s scoring rubric, typographic artifacts included, and give each trait a criterion sentence that ends by labelling level 5 “native-like facility”, a phrase that the corpus’s rubric uses only for its holistic top level. The rubric versions are released with the panels (Appendix M ). The judges read these rubric versions, and the original raters read each benchmark’s own instructions. No judge sees labels, holistic scores, or sampling strata (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 分级面板的标准句子和级别描述来自我们为一项单独、未公布的标准汇总研究撰写的每个基准的文字版本,并在本研究的任何法官运作之前固定下来。 他们将 FED 和 USR 的问题重写为语句, 将 HelpSteer2 的 级别用词译为 帮助Steer2 , 并将 LFQA 的级别描述取自基准作者为 GPT-4 撰写的评分提示 。 对ELLIPSE来说,它们保留了对本体分数的级别描述,包括印刷文物,并给每个特征一个标准句子,结尾是贴上第5级 " 类似本地设施 " 的标签,这是本体分数只用于其整体顶级的短语。 标点版随面板发行(附录M. 法官们阅读这些标语版本,原始评分者阅读每个基准本身的指示. 没有任何法官看到标签、整体分数或取样层(附录A )。

blocks.en: 3.4 Labels and reference points
blocks.zh: 3.4 标签和参考点

blocks.en: The human label of a graded pair is the mean of its raters’ levels, rounded to the nearest level with halves rounded up. Half-way means account for 46.8% of ELLIPSE labels and at most two labels on any other panel. The label of a binary pair is the rater majority, or on RiceChem the TA annotation (Table 1 ). A unanimous pair is one on which all raters give the same level, and a split pair is one on which they do not.
blocks.zh: 分级配对的人类标签是其评分等级的平均值,四舍五入到最接近的等级,四舍五入。 半途指占ELLIPSE标签的46.8%,在任何其他面板上最多有两个标签. 二进制配对的标签为评分多数,或者在RiceChem上的TA注释(表1). 一对一致的一对是所有评分者都给予同样水平的一对,一对分割的一对是他们没有的.

blocks.en: The rater reference scores each rater against the rounded mean of the other raters on the same pair, pooled over raters. It exists on the six graded panels that release more than one rating per pair. HelpSteer2’s label is the rounded mean of the three annotators who agree most, and its per-annotator ratings, published separately, were not used. On HealthBench, pairs whose physicians tied had left the pool before sampling, which makes a physician reference usable on only 50 pairs (Appendix D ). The reference’s target averages one rater fewer than the label, so the reference shows where a single rater lands and does not bound what a judge can reach (in exact accuracy, Jev Choice exceeds it on LFQA and USR-TC; Table 2 and Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 计量员参考分数为每名计量员相对于同一对计量员上其他计量员的四舍五入平均值的分数,集合数高于计量员。 它存在于6个分级的面板上,每对发布一个以上的评分. HelpSteer2的标签是三个最同意的注解者四舍五入的平均值,其单独发布的每注解者评分没有被使用. 在Health Bench, 医生捆绑的对子在取样前离开了游泳池,这使得医生的参考文献仅可用于50对(附录D)。 参考标准的目标平均值比标签低1倍,因此参考标准显示一个单一的评分者着陆的地点,并不约束法官所能达到的目标(准确的说,Jev Choice在LFQA和USR-TC上超过了它;表2和附录A)。

blocks.en: Two no-read baselines , fitted on the evaluated pairs, predict labels without reading the unit. HelpSteer2’s is a constant predictor that names each attribute’s most frequent level, and it reaches 60.0% exact accuracy (Section 3.5 ). LFQA’s, the provenance baseline, reads only whether ChatGPT or a Reddit user wrote the answer and reaches 68.1%, with a mean QWK of 0.28.
blocks.zh: 两个不读的基线,安装在被评价的对子上,预测不读单元的标签。 帮助 指针2是一个恒定的预测器,指向每个属性最频繁的级别,精确度达到60.0%(第3.5节)。 LFQA是来源基准,只读查特GPT还是Reddit用户写出答案,达到68.1%,平均QWK为0.28.

blocks.en: 3.5 Metrics and statistics
blocks.zh: 3.5 计量和统计

blocks.en: Pairs of graded criteria are ordinal pairs . Exact accuracy is the share of ordinal pairs whose predicted level equals the label, and within-one accuracy also counts a one-level miss as correct. Mean QWK is the unweighted mean of the per-criterion quadratic-weighted kappas ( Cohen, 1968 ) . A judge’s offset on a criterion or panel is the mean of its predicted minus labelled level over the ordinal pairs, and its gap is its exact accuracy minus that of the rater reference, in points, negative where the judge falls short of the raters. On binary criteria we report verdict accuracy (the share of binary pairs whose verdict equals the label), Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) , and the MET-rate offset (the predicted minus the labelled MET rate, in points). Because chance-level exact accuracy changes with the number of levels, panels are compared through mean QWK, the offset, or the gap, never through the level of exact accuracy. Differences between reported values are computed before rounding, and stated bounds such as “at most” compare rounded values.
blocks.zh: 等级标准的对称是正数对。 准确的精确度是预言水平等于标签的正弦对子的比例,在1之内的精确度也算一个一级误差是正确的. 平均QWK是每克里特尔二次加权卡帕斯的未加权平均值(Cohen,1968年). 法官在标准或面板上的抵消是其预测的负标水平相对于正数对的平均值,其差距是其准确的准确度减去评分参考值,在评分低于评分时为负值。 根据二进制标准,我们报告判定的准确性(二进制对子的评分,其评分等于标签),科恩的ox\kappa(Cohen,1960年),以及MET率的抵消(预测值减去标注的MET率,以点表示). 由于机会级精确准确度随水平数量的变化而变化,所以面板通过平均QWK,抵消,或间隙来比较,从不通过精确准确度的水平来比较. 在四舍五入之前计算出所报告数值之间的差异,并列出“最多”比较四舍五入值等界限。

blocks.en: We compare two judges on the pairs both scored. Their paired accuracy difference is the number of those pairs that only the second judge gets right, minus the number that only the first gets right, over the number both scored. Pairs of one unit share its text, so we resample units with replacement, 10,000 times per comparison, and take percentile intervals of the difference. Two judges are separated when the 95% interval excludes zero. Two judges are at parity when the 90% interval of their accuracy difference lies within 5 points of zero, which amounts to two one-sided tests of equivalence at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . A comparison that shows neither separation nor parity is inconclusive . We set the 5-point margin after the verdicts were collected, so Table C1 also gives the smallest margin that each comparison supports. Holm correction over the 27 comparisons of Jev Choice with an LLM judge uses the bootstrap p p -value, twice the smaller share of replicates on either side of zero. Pair-level sign tests, which ignore clustering, and a sign test over units are in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们比较两个评委 在对两个得分。 他们配对的精度差异是那些只有第二名裁判获得对数的对数,减去只有第一名获得对数的对数,超过两个得分的数字. 一个单位的对等分享它的文字, 所以我们用替换来重现单位, 一次比较一万次, 并采用百分位间隔的差数。 当95%的间隔排除零时,两名法官被分开。 当其准确性差值的90%间隔在0的5点以内时,两位判官处于对等状态,相当于α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05的两个对等性的单面测试. 比较表明,既非离职,也非对等,是没有定论的。 我们在收集判决后设定了5点差值,因此表C1还给出了每个比较支持的最小差值. 在Jev Choice与LLM判断器的27个比较中,Holm校正使用靴子p-值,是零边两边复制品比例的两倍。 对等级标志测试,不考虑集群,对单位的标志测试载于附录C。

blocks.en: Abstentions and judge-call failures are excluded from denominators, so two judges’ accuracies share a denominator only in a paired comparison. The exception is DeepSeek’s three failed calls on the binary panels, which the harness recorded as UNMET verdicts (Appendix A ). The pair set also differs between analyses, which is why one judge’s accuracy on a panel differs between tables: Table 2 counts a graded panel’s ordinal pairs, the comparisons of Jev Choice in Table C1 add its embedded binary pairs and keep the pairs both judges scored, and Table 4 counts every pair Jev answered, keeping Jev’s verdict where the cascade’s fallback judge (Section 6 ) abstained.

blocks.en: Cost is the list price applied to recorded token usage, except for DeepSeek, whose per-response cost billed by OpenRouter we use (Appendix B ). Level shifts, cascades, and the other counterfactuals in this paper are post-hoc analyses of the collected verdicts, for which no judge was run again, and we label them wherever they appear.
blocks.zh: 成本(Cost)是适用于记录的象征性用途的列表价格,除了DeepSeek,我们使用的OpenRouter(附录B )为其收取的每笔响应费用。 级别变化,级联,以及本文中的其他反事实都是对所收集的判决的事后分析,对此没有法官再次运行,我们把它们标注在任何出现的地方.

blocks.en: 4 Jev’s Accuracy, Cost, and Speed
blocks.zh: 4 Jev的准确性、成本和速度

blocks.en: This section assesses Jev as a replacement for an LLM judge, weighing accuracy against money and time. The saving is large on every panel, whereas the accuracy difference depends on the kind of criterion and on which LLM judge Jev would replace, so we compare accuracy one LLM judge and one panel at a time before turning to price and wall time. The section ends with two choices that any use of Jev involves: how to phrase its question and whether to let it abstain.
blocks.zh: 本节将Jev评为LLM法官的替补,权衡准确性与金钱和时间. 每个面板的节省很大,而准确性差异则取决于LLM法官Jev将取代哪类标准,因此我们先比较一个LLM法官和一个面板的准确性,然后再考虑价格和墙壁时间。 本节结尾有Jev的任何使用都涉及的两种选择:如何表达其问题,以及是否让它弃权.

blocks.en: 4.1 Accuracy in paired comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 配对比较的准确性

blocks.en: Jev Choice ranks first on RiceChem, with 81.0% verdict accuracy against 76.1% to 79.2% for the LLM judges, and second on HealthBench, behind Gemini (Table 2 ). It is separated from Luna on both panels and from Gemini on RiceChem, and it is at parity with DeepSeek on both (Table C1 ).
blocks.zh: Jev Choice在RiceChem排名第一,判决准确度为81.0%,LLM法官为76.1%至79.2%,在Health Bench排名第二,落后于双子座(表2)。 它与Luna在两个面板上分离,与双子座在RiceChem上分离,与DeepSeek在两个面板上均匀(表C1)。

blocks.en: Of the 21 comparisons on the graded panels, 16 do not separate Jev Choice from an LLM judge. The largest separation is Gemini’s lead on ELLIPSE, 16.4 points (95% interval 14.1 to 18.7). Gemini is also ahead on FED-Dialogue and HelpSteer2. The other two separations involve Luna, which leads on USR-PC and trails Jev Choice on HelpSteer2, and DeepSeek is never separated from Jev Choice. Parity holds in 6 of the 21 graded comparisons, three with Luna, two with DeepSeek, and one with Gemini. The other 10 have 90% intervals that reach between 5.3 and 8.3 points from zero, so these samples can neither separate the judges nor show them equivalent.
blocks.zh: 在对分级小组的21个比较中,16个没有将Jev Choice与LLM法官分开。 最大的分离是双子座领先的ELLIPSE,16.4分(95%间隔14.1至18.7). 双子座也领先于FED-对话与HelpSteer2. 另外两段分离涉及Luna,它引领着USR-PC和追踪Jev Choice on HelpSteer2,DeepSeek从未与Jev Choice分开. 平价在21级比较中占据6位,3位与月球,2位与深赛克,1位与双子座. 其他10种的间隔为90%,从零到5.3到8.3点之间,因此这些样本既不能将裁判分开,也不能显示等效.

blocks.en: Over all 27 comparisons, Holm correction keeps four separations, two in each direction: Gemini’s leads on ELLIPSE and on FED-Dialogue, and Jev Choice’s leads over Luna on HelpSteer2 and over Gemini on RiceChem. Because several units can share a HelpSteer2 prompt, an LFQA question, or a USR context, we also resample these sampling groups instead of units, which changes four outcomes (Appendix C ). Luna’s lead on USR-PC loses its separation, Jev Choice’s lead over DeepSeek on LFQA gains one, and two comparisons lose parity, which leaves eight separations, five of them Jev Choice’s leads.
blocks.zh: 所有27个比较, Holm校正保留了四个分离,每个方向两个:双子座领先于ELLIPSE和FED-对话,以及Jev Choice领先于Luna在HelpSteer2和双子座领先于RiceChem. 由于几个单位可以共享一个HelpSteer2 的即时,一个LFQA问题,或者一个USR上下文,所以我们也对这些抽样组进行重采,而不是单位,这四个结果(Appendix C )都会改变. 卢娜在USR-PC上的领先失去其分离,Jev Choice在LFQA上的领先比DeepSeek获得1分,两次比较失去均价,这导致8次分离,其中5次是Jev Choice的领先.

blocks.en: Jev Choice is never the most accurate matched judge on a graded panel. It ranks second to fourth, and Gemini is the most accurate, or tied for it, everywhere except LFQA. Every judge falls short of the rater reference on ELLIPSE, FED-Dialogue, and USR-PC, and on ELLIPSE the best of them, Gemini, reaches 29.8% exact accuracy where the reference reaches 51.4%. HelpSteer2’s constant predictor (60.0%) is more accurate than every judge, significantly so in pair-level sign tests against all but Gemini ( p = 0.075 p=0.075 ). Both separations on that panel, Jev Choice’s lead over Luna and Gemini’s over Jev Choice, therefore rank judges that trail a constant. Against LFQA’s provenance baseline no judge’s exact accuracy differs significantly in a pair-level sign test, although every matched judge’s mean QWK, 0.43 to 0.51, is above the baseline’s 0.28, a difference we did not test (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: Jev Choice在评分板上从未是最准确的配对法官. 它排在第二位至第四位,除LFQA外,各地双子座是最准确的,或与之相连的. 在ELLIPSE、FED-Dialogue和USR-PC上,每个法官都未达到评分参考,在ELLIPSE上,最优秀的双子座评分达到29.8%的准确度,参考率达到51.4%。 帮助Steer2的恒定预测器(60.0%)比每个判断器更准确,在对除双子座之外的所有双子座标志测试(p = 0.075 p = 0.075 ) 中都明显如此。 该面板上的两种分离,即Jev Choice领先于月亮,而Gemini领先于Jev Choice,因此对跟随常数的法官进行排名。 与LFQA的源头基准相比,没有一位法官的准确性在对位标志测试中有很大差异,尽管每个匹配的法官的平均QWK(0.43至0.51)高于基线的0.28,我们没有测试这一差异(附录H )。

blocks.en: 4.2 Jev is cheaper and faster than every LLM judge
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). Jev比每个LLM法官都便宜和快

blocks.en: Over the nine panels Jev Choice cost $0.063 (Table B1 ). Luna cost 29 times as much, DeepSeek 66 times, and Gemini 325 times. On single panels the ratio ranges from 18 (Luna on HealthBench) to 770 (Gemini on FED-Dialogue). Jev Choice finished the nine panels in 29 seconds of wall time. Luna took 859 seconds, Gemini 950, and DeepSeek 6,298, between 30 and 220 times as long as Jev Choice. These ratios understate Jev’s advantage at equal concurrency. Each Jev framing sent 8 requests at a time on the graded panels, with Jev Choice and Jev Score running together against one API, whereas each LLM judge sent 16 to 32 to its own provider.
blocks.zh: 在9个小组中,Jev选择费用为0.063美元(表B1)。 露娜花费29倍,深塞克66倍,双子座325倍. 在单一面板上,比例从18(Luna on Health Bench)到770(Gemini on FED-对话)不等。 Jev Choice在29秒的墙时间里完成了9个面板. 卢纳用了859秒,双子座950,深塞克6,298,距离Jev Choice还有30到220倍. 这些比率低估了Jev的等值货币优势。 每个 Jev Framing一次在分级板上发出8项请求,Jev Choice和Jev Score对一个API一起运行,而每个LLM法官向自己的提供者发送了16至32份请求.

blocks.en: The cost ratio tends to grow with the number of criteria per unit, because each criterion adds an LLM call but no Jev request (Section 3.1 ). For Gemini it rises from 121 on HealthBench, with 2.0 criteria per unit, to its maximum on FED-Dialogue, with 10, and across the graded panels it rises with every increase in criteria per unit. RiceChem departs from that order, and the Luna and DeepSeek ratios follow it less closely (Appendix B ). Gemini’s per-token price and its reasoning tokens widen its cost ratio further. A harness that grades all of a unit’s criteria in one call, or an LLM judge run without reasoning, would narrow the ratios. We costed neither, and their effect on accuracy is unknown.
blocks.zh: 成本比率往往随着每个单位的标准数量而增加,因为每个标准都增加了LLM调用,但没有Jev请求(第3.1节)。 对于双子座来说,它从健康奔驰(Health Bench)上的121个,每单位有2.0个标准,到FED-对话(Dialogue)上的最高值,有10个标准,在分级的板块上,每单位每增加一个标准,它就会上升. 稻米 Chem偏离了这一顺序,而月球和深层猎物比率跟不上它(附录B)。 双子座价格及其推理标志进一步扩大了成本比率。 利用一个电话中所有单位标准的分级,或者一个LLM法官在没有推理的情况下运行,将会缩小比例。 我们没有计算费用,而且对准确性的影响不明。

blocks.en: 4.3 Framing and abstention
blocks.zh: 4.3 诽谤和弃权

blocks.en: Jev Noul and Jev Choice give nearly the same verdicts on binary criteria, with Cohen’s κ = 0.945 \kappa=0.945 between them over the 8,392 pairs of the full RiceChem set, which only Jev judged. Their accuracies differ by 0.9 points on RiceChem and 0.2 on HealthBench. The wrapper matters more, adding 10.7 points over bare Noul on RiceChem, though only 1.0 point on HealthBench (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: Jev Noul和Jev Choice对二进制标准做出了几乎相同的判决,Cohen ob = 0.945\kappa = 0.945 在8,392对完整的 RiceChem 套装上,只有Jev判断。 他们的敏锐度在RiceChem和Health Bench上相差0.9分. 包装更为重要,在RiceChem上增加了10.7分,虽然在Health Bench上只增加了1.0分(附录D).

blocks.en: Jev Score is separated from Jev Choice on four graded panels (ELLIPSE, FED-Turn, FED-Dialogue, and USR-TC), each time in its own favour (Table C1 ), and has the higher within-one accuracy on all seven. Its exact accuracy is lower, without separation, on HelpSteer2 and USR-PC. The difference between the two framings exceeds the spread among the three LLM judges only on FED-Turn, where it is 10.5 points against a spread of 2.9 and Jev Score has the highest exact accuracy of any judge (Table 2 ). There they differ most in their use of the middle level, “Somewhat.”, which the labels use on 32.6% of pairs, Jev Score on 29.1%, and Jev Choice on 11.2%. Reading each framing’s probabilities with the other’s decoding rule, a post-hoc analysis, shows that most or all of the difference comes from the probabilities the two primitives return and little or none from the decoding rules (Appendix E , where Figure E1 also compares the framings on every panel).
blocks.zh: Jev Score在4个分级面板(ELLIPSE,FED-Turn,FED-Dialogue,和USR-TC)上与Jev Choice分开,每次都有利于自己(表C1),在所有7个面板上,其内置精度都更高. 在HelpSteer2和USR-PC上,它的精确度较低,没有分离. 两个框架之间的差异超过三个LLM法官之间的差幅,仅在FED-Turn上,在FED-Turn上是10.5分,差幅为2.9,而Jev Score是任何法官最准确的(表2)。 在中间一级,它们使用最多的是“Something.”,标签使用32.6%的对数,Jev得分29.1%,Jev选择11.2%。 阅读每个框架的概率与另一个框架的解码规则,一个后热分析显示,大部分或全部差异来自两个原始人返回的概率,很少或没有来自解码规则(Appendix E,其中图E1也比较了每个面板上的帧).

blocks.en: Offered the NA option, Jev Choice abstained on 28 of the 3,414 ordinal pairs. Seventeen of them are on FED-Dialogue error_recovery , the one criterion on which the raters often answered N/A. Jev Choice’s probability for the NA option rises with the number of raters who did (Spearman ρ = 0.62 \rho=0.62 over 25 dialogues), and the LLM judges abstain largely on the same pairs (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: 提供了NA选项,Jev Choice在3,414对正弦对中的28对弃权. 其中17项是关于FED-Dial rogue error_ recovery(英语:FED-Dial roads_ recovery)的,这是评分者经常回答不适用的一个标准. Jev Choice对NA选项的概率随着给出的评分数(Spearman $ = 0.62\rho = 0.62 / 25个对话框)的增加而上升,LLM评委基本上对相同的对数投弃权票(Appendix F ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Judge–judge agreement exceeds judge–label agreement
blocks.zh: 5.1 法官-法官协议超过法官-标签协议

blocks.en: The judge–judge row of Table 2 exceeds the judge–label row on all seven graded panels, and on five of them even the least-agreeing pair of judges agrees more closely than the best judge agrees with the labels. Label noise alone could produce this pattern (Section 5.5 ). So could a common offset, which lowers each judge’s agreement with the labels but not its agreement with the other judges (Section 5.2 ). The judges’ errors also overlap. All four are wrong on 64.0% of ELLIPSE pairs, and a post-hoc selection of whichever judge is right on each pair would reach only the remaining 36.0%, below the rater reference. ELLIPSE is the only panel with a rater reference on which such a selection stays below it (Table J2 ).
blocks.zh: 法官-表2的排位超过了法官-所有7个级别评委的标签排位,对其中5个级别评委来说,即使最不认同的对位评委也比最佳评委更认同标签。 仅标签噪音就可能产生这种模式(第5.5节)。 共同抵消也可以降低每位法官对标签的同意,而不是与其他法官的协议(第5.2节)。 法官的错误也相互重叠。 所有四对在64.0%的ELLIPSE配对上都是错的,每对配对上哪个法官的选修后只能达到剩余的36.0%,低于评分参考. ELLIPSE是唯一一个具有评分法参考的面板,这种评分法保留在其以下(表J2)。

blocks.en: 5.2 The gap concentrates in criteria with negative offsets
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 差距集中在标准上,负数抵消

blocks.en: Across the 31 graded criteria with a rater reference (all but HelpSteer2’s four), the four matched judges’ mean offset tracks their mean gap (Spearman ρ = 0.92 \rho=0.92 ; Figure 2 ). Most of this correlation is mechanical, because a large offset forces low exact accuracy. It locates the gap without testing its cause. With cut-offs chosen only to describe the pattern, 11 of the 12 criteria more than 15 points below the reference have a mean offset below − 0.5 -0.5 levels (Appendix G ). Each of the 15 criteria whose mean offset lies within 0.3 levels of zero is at most 6 points below the reference (the shaded band of Figure 2 ). The offsets also agree in sign across judges. All four are negative on 25 of all 35 graded criteria, HelpSteer2’s included, and all four are positive on 2.
blocks.zh: 在31个等级标准中,除了HelpSteer2的4个标准外,其余4个标准都与法官的平均抵消率相匹配(Spearman $ = 0.92\rho = 0.92;图2)。 这种关联大多是机械的,因为巨大的抵消力会降低精确度. 它在不测试原因的情况下找到缺口。 由于选择了仅用于描述模式的截断,12项标准中的11项标准在参考点以下15点以上,平均抵消低于−0.5-0.5级(附录G)。 15项标准中,每项标准的平均抵消幅度在0.3级零以下,最高低于参考值(图2的阴影带)。 抵消额也由法官们签署。 在所有35个等级标准中,4个标准都是负数的,包括HelpSteer2,4个标准都是负数的。

blocks.en: 5.3 A constant shift removes most of the gap
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 恒移可以消除大部分间隙

blocks.en: A judge’s location on a criterion is the part of the scale on which it places the criterion’s units. To measure how much of the gap is location, we shift each judge’s predictions on a criterion, post hoc, by the whole number of levels that maximizes its exact accuracy, clipped to the scale, and choose the shift for each pair from the criterion’s other pairs (a leave-one-out shift). After this shift the mean gap no longer tracks the offset (Spearman ρ = 0.16 \rho=0.16 , p = 0.40 p=0.40 ), and no criterion stays more than 8.4 points below the unshifted reference. The comparison favours the judges where most labels are at the top of a three-level scale, because a clipped shift of one level then partly amounts to predicting the top level and would raise a rater’s agreement too. Giving the judges and the rater reference each their own best shift leaves four criteria more than 5 points below the shifted reference, led by FED-Dialogue informative ( − 16.2 -16.2 points) and LFQA factuality ( − 12.7 -12.7 ; Appendix G ). On the other 27, the shifted judges are at most 5 points below the shifted rater reference.
blocks.zh: 法官在某一标准上的位置是标准单位的级别。 为了衡量差距的多少是位置,我们把每个法官的预测根据一个标准,即事后的预测,按照能使其准确性最大化的全部水平,剪切到比例尺,并从标准的其他对位中选择每对位的转变(留一移). 在此转移后,平均差距不再跟踪偏移(Spearman à = 0.16\rho = 0.16,p = 0.40 p = 0.40),任何标准都不得停留在未转移的参考文献的下方8.4点以上。 比较有利于评委,因为大多数评分都位于三级评分的首位,因为一个等级的略微转变相当于对最高等级的预测,也会提高评分员的一致。 给法官和评分员每一次最佳轮班都留下了四个标准,比调整后的轮班低5点以上,这些标准由FED-对话提供信息(−16.2-16.2分)和LFQA事实质量(−12.7-12.7;附录G)牵头。 在其他27个案件中,被调换的法官最多低于调换的评分参考。

blocks.en: ELLIPSE has the largest offsets. The matched judges’ offsets run from − 0.77 -0.77 levels (Gemini) to − 1.28 -1.28 (Luna), and Jev Choice’s is − 1.25 -1.25 . Jev Choice places 86.1% of its predictions below the label and 0.5% above it, so nearly all of its errors lie in one direction. The judges rarely use the top of the scale (Figure 3 a). The labels put 36.3% of pairs at levels 4 and 5, and no judge puts more than 4.2% there. Half-up rounding of the labels accounts for about 0.23 levels of Jev Choice’s offset and does not change the sign of any judge’s offset (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: ELLIPSE的抵消额最大。 相应的法官抵消额从− 0.77-0.77级(Gemini)增至− 1.28-1.28级(Luna),Jev Choice的抵消额为− 1.25-1.25。 Jev Choice将86.1%的预测置于标签下方,而上方为0.5%,因此几乎所有错误都位于一个方向. 法官很少使用比额表的顶部(图3a)。 标签将36.3%的对分为4级和5级,没有法官将超过4.2%。 标签的半整数占Jev Choice抵消的0.23级左右,并不改变任何法官抵消的标志(附录G)。

blocks.en: The offset leaves the order of the essays largely intact. The mean of the option values that a judge chose for an essay’s six traits correlates with the essay’s holistic score at Spearman ρ = 0.62 \rho=0.62 to 0.72 0.72 across the matched judges (Table C3 d). On single traits Jev Choice’s rank agreement with the raters is close to one rater’s with the other (Appendix G ).

blocks.en: 5.4 Natural contrasts and candidate conventions
blocks.zh: 5.4 自然对比和候选公约

blocks.en: Table 3 lists the clearest candidate conventions, of three kinds: a population norm, a corpus-relative standard, and annotation habits. We identified them by reading the judges’ errors. Since the judges read our rubric versions and the raters their benchmark’s own instructions (Section 3.3 ), a convention absent from our texts may be stated in what the raters read. We checked this only on ELLIPSE, whose source rubric we compared with ours. Four natural contrasts bear on the candidates. None was designed as an experiment, and only the first three hold one factor approximately fixed.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了三种最明确的候选公约:人口规范、与实体有关的标准以及注释习惯。 我们通过阅读法官的错误来识别他们。 由于法官们阅读了我们的标题版本,而评分者们也阅读了自己的基准指示(第3.3节),因此可以在评分者们所读到的内容中说明我们的案文中没有的公约。 我们只检查了ELLIPSE, 我们比较了它的源头。 四个自然对比对候选人有影响。 无一被设计为实验,只有前三个有大约固定的一个系数.

blocks.en: The first contrast varies the judge and holds the pairs fixed. Every judge’s offset is negative on the six graded panels other than USR-TC (Tables 2 and C3 ), and besides three LLM judges from three vendors, the judges include Jev Choice, which never sees the harness prompt, and Jev Score, which decodes by expected level. Neither a shared prompt nor a shared decoding rule is therefore the common cause.
blocks.zh: 第一个对比使法官不同,并持有对称固定. 除了USR-TC(表2和C3)之外,每名法官在六个级别小组中的抵消都是负数,除了三个供应商的三名LLM法官外,法官还包括从未看到拉带的Jev Choice和按预期水平解码的Jev Score。 因此,共同的即时规则和共同的解码规则都不是共同的原因。

blocks.en: The second contrast, on the USR panels, holds the criterion text fixed and changes the corpus. Their five criterion texts are byte-identical on Topical-Chat and PersonaChat. On engaging , however, the matched judges’ offset is large on PersonaChat and small on Topical-Chat (Table 3 ), and PersonaChat’s raters gave the top level in 59.4% of their ratings, against 34.7% on Topical-Chat. The judges order responses similarly on both corpora (Spearman ρ = 0.50 \rho=0.50 to 0.72 0.72 with the rater mean), so the corpora differ in where the judges place responses relative to the labels. A post-hoc shift of one level up raises every matched judge’s exact accuracy on PersonaChat from at most 26.7% to at least 69.5% and lowers it on Topical-Chat (Figure 3 c). Part of that rise is mechanical, because 63.3% of the PersonaChat labels are at the top level. A rater given its own best shift reaches 80.0%, and the shifted judges average 5.1 points below it (Appendix G ). We read the PersonaChat labels as corpus-relative. The contrast holds the text fixed but leaves other differences. Topical-Chat responses are grounded in facts, which the top level (“presents an interesting fact”) mentions, and raters were assigned to contexts in rotation on Topical-Chat and in fixed triples on PersonaChat.

blocks.en: The third contrast varies the criterion within a rubric, where the judges, prompt, and units stay the same. ELLIPSE’s best and worst traits differ in what their level descriptions name. The trait cohesion , whose level descriptions name observable devices, is every judge’s best. Every judge does worst on grammar , whose levels differ only by the quantifiers “throughout”, “many”, “some”, “minimal”, and “few or no” (Table 3 ). The cohesion trait still carries an offset of − 0.52 -0.52 to − 0.62 -0.62 levels, and with six traits the level descriptions cannot be distinguished from other trait differences, such as criterion length (Appendix H ). Every matched judge also agrees best with the HelpSteer2 labels on verbosity , which describes an amount of detail visible in the response.

blocks.en: The fourth contrast varies the form of the criterion. For Jev, moving from binary to graded criteria reverses the direction of the error, although this contrast also changes panel, domain, and label source. Jev over-grants MET on both binary panels (Appendix D ), where the LLM judges’ MET-rate offsets have no common sign (Table 2 ). Its graded offsets, by contrast, are negative outside USR-TC. The two embedded binary criteria of USR-TC split in direction. Every judge over-grants MET on understandable (Jev Noul’s MET rate is 90.3% against 68.1% labelled) and under-grants it on uses_knowledge (37.5% against 58.3%). On the same responses, then, the direction of every judge’s error follows the criterion, so Jev’s reversal need not come from the change of form itself.
blocks.zh: 第四个对照标准的形式不同。 对于Jev来说,从二进制标准向分级标准移动会反转错误的方向,尽管这个对比也会改变面板,域,和标签来源. Jev在两个二进制面板(附录D)上的超额赠款MET, LLM法官的MET率抵消没有共同的标志(表2)。 相反,在USR-TC之外,其分级抵消是负数。 USR-TC的两个嵌入式二进制标准在方向上分裂. 每名法官根据可以理解性(Jev Noul的MET率是90.3%,对68.1%的标签)获得过多的MET,而使用量不足(37.5 %对58.3%)。 在同样的回答上,每个法官的错误方向都遵循标准,因此Jev的逆转不需要来自形式变化本身.

blocks.en: Two rows of Table 3 , ELLIPSE and LFQA, are argued from the texts and labels themselves. We read ELLIPSE’s labels as carrying a population norm. Its level descriptions come from the corpus’s English-proficiency scoring rubric, which its trained raters applied to essays by English learners in grades 8 to 12 ( Crossley et al., 2023 ) . The judges received those same descriptions, so any population norm reached the raters through their training. A norm-referenced scale interprets a level relative to a population instead of a stated standard ( Glaser, 1963 ) , and rater training supplies expectations about the population and a reference group of other raters ( Weigle, 1994 ) . A zero-shot judge receives only the descriptions and our criterion sentence, which ends “(level 1 = lowest proficiency, level 5 = native-like facility)” (Section 3.3 ). A judge that reads “some errors” against native-like writing would place learner essays low. The offset may therefore reflect this label for level 5 as well as the missing population. The small-error penalty reported for LLM essay graders ( Mathew et al., 2026 ) offers another account, which these data do not distinguish from a population norm.
blocks.zh: 表3(ELLIPSE和LFQA)的两行是从文本和标签本身中论证出来的。 我们读到ELLIPSE的标签, 它的级别描述来自该校的英语专业评分,经过培训的评分员将其应用于8至12年级的英语学生的论文(Crossley等人,2023年)。 法官们得到了同样的描述,因此任何人口标准都通过培训达到评分标准。 参照规范的尺度可以解释相对于一个人群的层次,而不是一个声明的标准(Glaser,1963年),而评估者培训可以提供对人群和其他评估者的参考群体的期望(Weigle,1994年)。 零射门法官只得到描述和我们的标准句子,句子的结尾是 " 1级=最低熟练程度,5级=类似本地的设施 " (第3.3节)。 法官若将“一些错误”读作反对类似本地写作,将降低学习者作文的水平。 因此,抵消额可能反映第5级的这一标签以及失踪人口。 对LLM散文分级者(Mathew等人,2026年)报告的轻度惩罚提供了另一个说法,这些数据与人口规范没有区别.

blocks.en: LFQA’s raters grant the top factuality level far more often than Jev Choice does (Table 3 ). Two of three raters placed each of the two ChatGPT answers quoted in Appendix H at that level, and in both the three LLM judges object to the same false claims, which the top-level text excludes.
blocks.zh: LFQA的评分比Jev Choice更频繁地给出最高的事实水平(表3)。 三个评分者中有两个将附录H所引用的两个ChatGPT解答分别放在该级别,在两个LLM评分中,三个评分者都反对相同的虚假主张,而上一级文本则排除了这种说法.

blocks.en: 5.5 Label noise, the harness prompt, and shared priors
blocks.zh: 5.5 标签噪声、诱饵和共享前科

blocks.en: Label noise alone does not explain the errors on ELLIPSE, LFQA factuality , or USR-TC uses_knowledge . Zero-mean noise in the labels would scatter the errors on both sides of the label, but almost all of Jev Choice’s ELLIPSE errors lie below it (Section 5.3 ). Noise would also concentrate the errors on split pairs, yet Jev Choice is wrong more often on unanimous LFQA factuality pairs than on split ones, and on the 18 USR-TC pairs whose context has no fact (the _nofact pairs), where Jev Noul answers UNMET on 16, 17 of the raters’ MET labels are unanimous (Table 3 ). Elsewhere the evidence that the judges place units lower than the raters do is weaker. On a three-level scale whose labels are mostly at the top, a judge that uses fewer levels than the raters shows a negative mean offset even without placing units lower. Criterion length, unit length, rater expertise, and scale width do not order the panels by Jev Choice’s gap (Appendix H ). The panel with the largest gap, ELLIPSE, is the one rated by trained raters, which is weak evidence against an account based on label quality.
blocks.zh: 标签噪音本身并不能解释ELLIPSE、LFQA事实质量或USR-TC使用_知识上的错误。 标签中的零度噪音会把错误分散在标签的两侧,但几乎所有Jev Choice的ELLIPSE错误都位于标签下方(第5.3节). Jev Choice更是错在一致的LFQA事实配对上, 在其他地方,法官将单位低于评分标准的证据较弱。 在标签大多位于顶端的三级尺度上,使用比评分数少的级别的法官显示负平均抵消,即使没有将单位置于较低位置。 标准长度、单位长度、评分器专门知识和尺度宽度并不通过Jev Choice的空白(附录H)来命令面板。 差距最大的面板ELLIPSE是由受过训练的评分员评分的面板,这是不利于基于标签质量的账户的薄弱证据.

blocks.en: Although Section 5.4 rules out the harness prompt as the common cause, its instructions, such as its rule for self-contradicting submissions (Section 3.2 ), may still add to the LLM judges’ offsets. Jev Choice, without them, is nonetheless offset further on ELLIPSE than Gemini and DeepSeek (Table 2 ). A reluctance to grant high levels, shared by all judges, is harder to exclude. It would produce a larger offset where raters use the top level more, which is the pattern of USR engaging . The embedded binary criteria rule out only a general bias toward failing verdicts, because all judges over-grant MET on understandable .
blocks.zh: 虽然第5.4节排除了即时利用这一共同原因,但其指示,例如关于自我对抗提交文件的规则(第3.2节),仍可能增加LLM法官的抵消额。 与双子座和DeepSeek(表2)相比,Jev Choice在ELLIPSE上被进一步抵消。 所有法官都不愿意给予高额法官待遇,这更难排除。 如果评级人更多地使用最高层,则会产生更大的抵消,而最高层则是USR参与的模式。 内置的二进制标准只排除了对失败判决的普遍偏见,

blocks.en: Priors shared through overlapping training data could also produce correlated errors ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . Giving the same texts to untrained human readers, or giving the judges exemplars, would distinguish that account from missing conventions.
blocks.zh: 通过重叠培训数据共享的先例也可能产生相关错误(Kim等人,2025年)。 向未经培训的人类读者提供同样的文本,或向法官提供实例,将这一说法与缺失的公约区分开来。

blocks.en: 6 Correlated Errors Undo the Cascade Advantage
blocks.zh: 6 串联错误 撤消叠加优势

blocks.en: A cascade lets a cheap judge answer every pair and sends the pairs whose confidence falls below a threshold τ \tau , the deferred pairs , to a fallback judge . The cheap judge’s verdict stands on the remaining kept pairs . A cheap judge whose confidence tracks its own errors is the natural first stage of a cascade, whose accuracy can exceed the fallback’s only through kept pairs on which the cheap judge alone is right. The gain is therefore limited by how few such pairs exist and by how well confidence finds them. On most graded panels, the less confident Jev is, the more often it is wrong (Section 6.1 ), yet the LLM judges repeat its wrong answers beyond what independent errors would produce, most strongly where Jev is most confident (Section 6.2 ). The replayed cascades therefore save cost on most panels but gain little over the best single judge (Section 6.3 ), and no median jury improves significantly on the most accurate matched judge (Section 6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 一个级联让一个便宜的法官回答每一对, 并把信心低于门槛的对 \ tau, 被推迟的对, 交给一个倒置的法官。 廉价法官的判决维持在剩下的一对。 一个低廉的法官,其信心追踪自己的错误是级联的自然第一阶段,其准确性只能通过低廉的法官们自己认为对的固定对子来超过倒数。 因此,这种收益受到以下因素的限制:存在这种对夫妇的人数多寡,信心多好。 在大多数等级小组中,Jev越不信任,越是错(第6.1节),但LLM法官重复错误的答案,超越独立错误所产生的错误,最强烈的是Jev最有信心的地方(第6.2节)。 因此,重播的级联为大多数小组节省了费用,但比最佳的单一法官少得可怜(第6.3节),在最准确的法官方面,陪审团中位数没有明显改善(第6.4节)。

blocks.en: 6.1 Jev’s confidence ranks its own errors
blocks.zh: 6.1 Jev的信心将它自己的错误排在首位

blocks.en: Jev Choice’s errors gather among its less confident verdicts on every graded panel but ELLIPSE (Figure 4 a). On those six panels the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of its confidence for its own correctness is 0.57 to 0.70, embedded binary pairs included with their Noul confidence. ELLIPSE is the exception, with an AUROC of 0.49 and an error rate of 85.8% to 87.2% in every confidence band of width 0.25 that holds more than one pair (Appendix I ).
blocks.zh: Jev Choice的错误来自它对于除ELLIPSE(图4a)以外的每个分级面板不太有信心的判决。 在这6个面板上,接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)对自身正确性的信心范围为0.57至0.70,嵌入式二进制配对含努尔信心。 ELLIPSE是例外,AUROC为0.49,每个宽度0.25的置信带的误差率为85.8%至87.2%,并持有一对以上(附录一).

blocks.en: Confidence also fails on single criteria inside panels where it otherwise ranks errors. Its AUROC is 0.41 on LFQA factuality , against 0.70 for the panel, and 0.52 on USR-PC engaging . There Jev Choice is wrong on 83.1% of the pairs at a mean confidence of 0.72. These criterion-level values are post hoc and rest on 118 and 59 pairs. They suggest that confidence fails on criteria where most errors lie on one side of the label, though not on all of them (ELLIPSE vocabulary has an offset of − 1.28 -1.28 levels and an AUROC of 0.62). Confidence still ranks errors on HelpSteer2 correctness , whose labels track overall helpfulness (AUROC 0.76; Table I1 e).
blocks.zh: 在小组内,如果将错误排序,则对单一标准的信心也会下降。 其AUROC在LFQA事实质量上为0.41,而面板为0.70,在USR-PC操作上为0.52。 在平均信心为0.72的情况下,83.1%的对子选择是错误的。 这些标准等级的数值是临时的,停留在118和59对之上。 他们认为,在标签的一方存在大多数错误的标准上缺乏信心,尽管并非所有错误都存在(ELLIPSE词汇值为− 1.28-1.28级,AUROC值为0.62)。 信心仍然在HelpSteer2的正确性上排出错误,其标签跟踪总体帮助(AUROC 0.76;表I1 e).

blocks.en: 6.2 The LLM judges repeat Jev’s confident errors
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). LLM法官重复Jev的自信错误

blocks.en: When Jev Choice is wrong, an LLM verdict that gives the same wrong answer is a repeated error . The share of repeated errors among the LLM verdicts on Jev’s wrong pairs is our measure of the correlated errors of Section 1 . Judges that share an offset would often pick the same wrong level even if their errors were independent given the label, so we compare this share with an independence baseline : for each LLM verdict, the rate at which that judge gives Jev’s wrong answer on the other pairs with the same criterion and label. Over all of Jev Choice’s errors, the share exceeds the baseline on every graded panel, by 18.8 to 34.2 points on six of them and by 8.6 points on ELLIPSE, where each judge’s own tendency to place essays low already accounts for most of the repetition (Table I1 c). The excess peaks in Jev’s top confidence band on every panel (Figure 4 b). There 80.5% to 92.8% of the LLM judges’ verdicts on Jev’s wrong pairs repeat its answer, where the baseline predicts 33.6% to 63.7%.
blocks.zh: Jev Choice 错误时, 给出相同错误答案的 LLM 判断是重复错误 。 我们衡量第1节的相关错误, 分享抵消额的法官通常会选择同样的错误水平,即使他们的错误是独立的,所以我们把这一份额与独立的基线进行比较:对于每一项LLM判决,法官对具有相同标准和标签的其他对子给出Jev错误答案的比率。 在所有Jev Choice的错误中,每个分级板的分数都超过基线,其中6个分数的分数为18.8至34.2分,ELLIPSE分数为8.6分,其中每位法官自己将论文放在低位的倾向已经是大部分重复的原因(表I1 c)。 Jev在每个面板上最高信任带的超额峰值(图4b). LLM法官对Jev错配对的判决有80.5%至92.8%重复了答案,基线预测为33.6%至63.7%。

blocks.en: The confident-error sample holds Jev Choice’s 12 highest-confidence errors on each graded panel, 84 pairs in all (Table J1 ). In their verdicts on these pairs, the three LLM judges repeat Jev’s wrong answer 96.0% of the time (242 of 252), where the independence baseline gives 50.3%. HealthBench’s confident errors are Jev Noul’s and were sampled by a different rule. Of the 36 LLM verdicts on them, 32 give Jev’s answer, against 10.0 expected under the baseline (Appendix J ).
blocks.zh: Jev Choice的12个最高自信差错, 三位LLM法官在对这两人的判决中重复了Jev错误的回答:96.0%的时间(252次中的242次),其中独立基准给出了50.3%。 健康奔驰的自信错误是Jev Noul的错, 在对其作出的36项LLM判决中,32项给出了Jev的答案,而根据基线(附录J)预计为10.0。

blocks.en: If Jev’s confidence reflects how strongly the unit and the criterion text favour one answer, LLM judges that read the same text would give that answer too and would all miss a label that differs from it. The labels suggest a second reading. Most confident errors sit on pairs whose raters disagree. Only 10 of the 72 on panels with several raters per pair are unanimous, and every FED and LFQA one is split (Appendix J ). On a split pair, part of what counts as a repeated error may be disagreement among the raters. That reading does not apply to the unanimous pairs, such as a USR-TC _nofact pair, or to HealthBench, where 11 of the 12 confident errors have unanimous physician labels.
blocks.zh: 如果Jev的信心反映出单位和标准文本对一个答案的支持程度,读同一文本的LLM法官也会给出这个答案,并且都会错过一个与之不同的标签. 标签建议进行二读。 最有自信的错误就发生在对子上,而对子的评分是不同的。 每对有数个评分率的72张面板中只有10张是一致的,每张FED和LFQA一张是分开的(Appendix J. 在一对拆分中,部分计为重复错误的可能是评分者之间的分歧. 这种读法不适用于一致的对子,例如USR-TC_nofact配对,也不适用于Health Bench,其中12个自信错误中有11个有一致的医生标签.

blocks.en: 6.3 Cascades lower cost but add little accuracy
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 混凝土成本较低,但增加的精度很少

blocks.en: As a post-hoc analysis we replay Jev-first cascades on the recorded verdicts. Jev Choice is the first stage on the graded panels and Jev Noul on the binary panels, where τ \tau is set on | P ⁡ ( yes ) − 0.5 | |P(\text{yes})-0.5| , half the confidence (Appendix K ). The best single judge is chosen from all judges, every Jev framing included. A threshold chosen on the same pairs on which it is evaluated is an oracle threshold , and the gains it gives are optimistic. A cross-fitted threshold is chosen on a random half of the units and evaluated on the other half. We average over 50 such halvings, and each half also chooses its fallback and its best single judge from its own pairs.
blocks.zh: 作为事后的分析 我们重播Jev的第一级联 在记录的判决。 Jev Choice是分级面板的第一阶段,Jev Noul是二进制面板的第一阶段,其中\ tau被设定在 \ P → → (是) → 0.5 → + P(\text{yes}) - 0.5 → 一半的置信度(附录 K ) 上. 从所有法官中挑选出最优秀的单一法官,包括每个Jev框架。 在评估时所选择的同一对的阈值是一个神谕阈值,它带来的收益是乐观的。 在任意的半个单位上选择一个交叉适应的阈值,并在另一半上进行评估. 我们平均有50多分,每半还从自己的配对中选择其倒数和最佳的单一裁判。

blocks.en: With cross-fitted thresholds, no cascade beats the best single judge by more than 1.5 points on average over the halvings, a margin reached on HealthBench (Table 4 ). The cascade falls below the best single judge on six of the nine panels, by 0.1 to 7.3 points, and its gain is positive in more than half of the halvings only on HealthBench, USR-PC, and LFQA. Oracle thresholds raise the largest gain to 2.0 points, again on HealthBench, but neither that gain nor the next largest, 1.3 points on USR-PC, is significant in a pair-level sign test on the kept pairs (Table K2 ). Jev Score, the best single judge on FED-Turn, beats every FED-Turn cascade by at least 5.2 points.
blocks.zh: 采用相互适应的阈值,任何级联均不会比最佳单一法官平均高出1.5分以上,这在健康本奇(表4)上达到了这一差数。 级联在9个板块中的6个板块上低于最佳单一裁判,以0.1比7.3的点数,其收益在仅针对Health Bench,USR-PC和LFQA的减半数中一半以上是积极的. Oracle阈值将最大增益提高到2.0分,同样在Health Bench上,但无论增益还是次大,USR-PC上的1.3分,在保存对子的对位标志测试中都不重要(表K2). Jev Score是FED-Turn上最好的单人裁判,每台FED-Turn级联至少击败5.2分.

blocks.en: Because the cascade and its fallback agree on the deferred pairs, their accuracies differ only through the kept pairs: a cascade − a fallback = s kept ​ ( a Jev kept − a fallback kept ) , a_{\text{cascade}}-a_{\text{fallback}}=s_{\text{kept}}\bigl(a^{\text{kept}}_{\text{Jev}}-a^{\text{kept}}_{\text{fallback}}\bigr), (1) where a a is accuracy and s kept s_{\text{kept}} the kept share. For the oracle-threshold cascades of Table 4 , kept pairs on which Jev alone is right are few on the graded panels, because on the pairs Jev keeps, Jev and the fallback are mostly right together and wrong together. For example, Jev alone is right on 10 of FED-Turn’s 306 kept pairs and Gemini alone on 8 (Table K2 ). Wherever one of these graded cascades beats its fallback, Jev and the fallback are within 2 points of each other on the kept pairs. The pairs that only Jev gets right also cap the gain, and on most graded panels Jev’s confidence keeps few of them. Measured against the fallback of Table 4 , Jev alone is right on only 12 to 37 pairs of a graded panel (Table C2 ), and on FED-Turn, LFQA, and USR-TC its confidence defers most of them to the fallback (Table K2 ). USR-PC, where Jev keeps 10 of its 16 such pairs, has the largest gain among the graded panels. The fallback’s lead on the deferred pairs, significant on six panels in pair-level sign tests, lifts a cascade above Jev alone, but by Equation ( 1 ) it cannot lift the cascade above the fallback.

blocks.en: When the best LLM judge is the fallback and thresholds are cross-fitted, the cascade costs 16% to 48% as much as that judge on six panels and loses 0.2 to 1.8 points of its held-out accuracy. It does better on RiceChem, where Jev alone is more accurate than the best LLM judge, costing 6.6% as much and gaining 1.2 points. Oracle thresholds reach the judge’s accuracy on the same six panels at 10% to 59% of its cost. Even with oracle thresholds, a cascade on ELLIPSE or FED-Dialogue must defer nearly every pair to match the best LLM judge (Appendix K ). What limits the cascade there is Jev’s accuracy. Jev Choice is separated behind Gemini on both panels (Section 4.1 ), and on ELLIPSE its confidence does not rank its errors.
blocks.zh: 当最优秀的LLM评委是倒计时,且阈值是交叉搭配的,级联成本为16%至48%,相当于6个板块上的评委,损失了0.2至1.8分的搁置准确度. Jev本身比最佳LLM法官更准确, Oracle阈值以10%至59%的成本达到法官在同一6个面板上的准确度。 即使有甲骨文阈值,ELLIPSE或FED-Dialogue上的级联也必须推迟几乎每对级联,以匹配最好的LLM判断器(附录K ). 校对:Soup Jev Choice在两个面板(第4.1节)后面被双子座分开,在ELLIPSE上,它的信心没有排出错误的顺序.

blocks.en: 6.4 Juries do not beat the best single judge
blocks.zh: 6.4 陪审团没有击败最好的单一法官

blocks.en: A jury pools the verdicts of several judges. On the pairs that all four matched judges scored, we take the median level of the three LLM judges, which on a binary pair is their majority, and compare it post hoc with the most accurate matched judge, which is chosen on those same pairs and so favoured by the comparison. That judge is also the best single judge of Section 6.3 on every panel except FED-Turn, where Jev Score is more accurate still. The median is never more accurate than that judge on any of the nine panels. It trails by up to 12.8 points on the graded panels (ELLIPSE), and its 95% interval lies wholly below zero on ELLIPSE, HelpSteer2, and RiceChem. A fourth juror, Jev Choice, never improves significantly on that judge either. The three-judge median also returns Jev’s wrong answer on 82 of the 84 pairs of the confident-error sample, and the label on one (Appendix J ).
blocks.zh: 陪审团汇集了几位法官的判决。 在四个配对的评委都得分的对数上,我们取了三位LLM评委的中位数,在二进制评委上,这三位评委是他们的多数,并将它与最准确的配对评委作比较,这些评委是在同一对评委上选择的,因此比较中偏好. 除了FED-Turn之外,该法官也是第6.3节中除Jev评分更准确的每组法官中最好的一名。 在9个小组中,中位数从未比法官更准确。 它在分级面板(ELLIPSE)上追逐最高达12.8分,其95%的间隔在ELLIPSE,HelpSteer2和RiceChem上完全低于零. 第四名陪审员Jev Choice 也从未大大改进过那个法官 三判中位数还返回了Jev在84对自信-错误样本中的82对错误答案,以及一个标签(附录J).

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: 7.1 Judge validation and judge combination
blocks.zh: 7.1 法官鉴定和法官组合

blocks.en: Comparing judges on the same pairs, as Section 4 does for Jev and three LLM judges, is the way to decide whether one judge can stand in for another, given enough pairs to be decisive. How close any judge comes to the raters is a separate question, and the answer appears to depend on what the raters knew beyond the text the judges read. In the two within-rubric contrasts of Section 5.4 , ELLIPSE cohesion and HelpSteer2 verbosity , the judges come closest where a level description points to something a reader can see in the unit. Where, on our reading, a level’s meaning depends on a population, a corpus, or an annotation habit, every judge falls short in the same direction, the best LLM judge included.
blocks.zh: 正如第4节对Jev和3名LLM法官所做的那样,对同对法官进行比较,是决定一名法官是否可以支持另一名法官的方法,因为有足够的对法官是决定性的。 任何法官对评委的接近程度是一个单独的问题,答案似乎取决于评委们除了法官们所读的文本之外所知道的. 在5.4节(ELLIPSE的凝聚力和HelpSteer2动词)的两种内在比喻中,评委们最接近于水平描述指向读者在单元中可以看到的东西. 依据我们的理解,一个级别的意义取决于一个人口、一个实体或一个注释习惯,每个法官都未能达到同样的方向,包括最佳的LLM法官。

blocks.en: The vendor lists literal reading of scoping words and negations among Jev’s known failure modes. 2 2 2 https://docs.typesafe.ai/model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 . The LLM judges share Jev’s offsets and most of its confident errors even though they emit reasoning tokens and their prompt tells them to watch negation and scope. One reading is that all of these judges read the criterion text as written. Shared training priors would produce the same pattern (Section 5.5 ), and our data do not separate the two accounts. If the first reading holds, agreement with labels on a graded rubric measures in part whether the judge was given the raters’ conventions, such as reading ELLIPSE essays against the population of learner essays they come from.
blocks.zh: 供应商列出了Jev已知的失败模式中对范围界定词的字面解读和否定。 LLM法官分享Jev的抵消和大部分自信错误, 一种读法是,所有这些法官都以书面阅读标准文本。 共享培训前科将产生同样的模式(第5.5节),我们的数据并不将这两个账户分开。 如果一读有效,则同意给法官打上分级标语的标签,部分衡量法官是否得到评分员的公约,如阅读ELLIPSE的散文,反对他们来自的学习者散文。

blocks.en: Jev’s confidence is informative enough on most graded panels to decide which pairs need an LLM judge, and the correlated errors of Section 6.2 largely account for both the cost saving and the small accuracy gain of the replayed cascades. Because the LLM judges tend to make Jev’s mistakes, keeping Jev’s confident verdicts costs little accuracy, which lets the cross-fitted cascades avoid most of what the best LLM judge would cost on most panels. For the same reason there is little accuracy to gain. On the pairs a cascade keeps, Jev and its fallback seldom differ in correctness, and on Jev’s most confident errors the LLM judges give Jev’s answer about twice as often as independent errors would. The same overlap helps explain why, in Section 6.4 , no median jury of the LLM judges beats the most accurate matched judge. We recommend that evaluations of combined judges report the share of repeated errors against an independence baseline (Section 6.2 ).
blocks.zh: Jev对大多数分级板的信心足以决定哪些对需要LLM法官,而第6.2节的相关错误在很大程度上说明了重播级联的节省成本和微小的准确性收益。 因为LLM法官往往会犯Jev的错误,所以保持Jev的自信判决不会花费多少准确性,这使得交叉搭配的级联可以避免大多数LLM法官在大多数小组上花费多少费用. 出于同样的原因,很难获得准确性。 Jev及其倒置者在正确性上很少有差异, 在Jev最有信心的错误上, LLM法官给出Jev答案的次数大约是独立错误的两倍。 同样的重叠有助于解释为什么在6.4节中,没有一个LLM法官的中位陪审团胜过最准确匹配的法官. 我们建议,对合并法官的评价应对照独立基线(第6.2节)报告重复错误的比例。

blocks.en: Table 5: Recommendations and the status of their evidence. Measured : a paired comparison or an exact computation from the recorded verdicts supports the recommendation on these panels, validated on held-out units only where marked cross-fitted. Observed : the data show the pattern without a test of the recommendation. Not tested : no experiment addressed it.
blocks.zh: 表5:建议及其证据状况。 测量:从记录的判决书中进行对等比较或精确计算,支持关于这些面板的建议,只有在有标记的交叉面板的情况下才能在被搁置的单元上验证。 央视:数据显示模式未测试推荐. 未测试 : 没有实验处理它。

blocks.en: 7.2 Recommendations
blocks.zh: 7.2 建议

blocks.en: The rubric-writing rows of Table 5 rest on observations that we did not test by intervention. Top levels worded as absolutes (“Entirely accurate”, “Fully clear and internally consistent throughout”) were read differently from the raters in both directions. Jev Choice seldom used LFQA’s absolute top factuality level, which the raters often chose (Section 5.4 ), whereas on five of its confident errors all five judges chose HelpSteer2’s absolute coherence top level where the label was one level lower (Appendix J ). Jev Choice never predicts the middle level on FED-Turn correct and fluent , whose texts state yes-or-no properties (Appendix E ). One global correction would not fit every trait, since the per-trait ELLIPSE offsets in Table 5 span more than a level.
blocks.zh: 表5的标注行以我们没有通过干预来检验的观察为依据。 最高水平作为绝对值(“完全准确”,“完全清楚,内部始终一致”)与两个方向的评级不同。 Jev Choice很少使用LFQA的绝对最高事实水平,而评分者经常选择这一水平(第5.4节),而在其5个自信的错误中,所有5名法官都选择了HelpSteer2的绝对一致性顶级,因为标签低一个级别(附录J ) 。 Jev Choice从未在FED-Turn正确和流利的上预言中间关卡,其文本表示是或否属性(附录E . 由于表5中每轨ELLIPSE抵消的数额超过一个水平,因此一个全球更正将不符合每个特征。

blocks.en: Beyond the rows of Table 5 , evaluations of rubric judges should separate unanimous from split pairs before interpreting errors, report each judge’s framing and decoding rule, and, when attributing a property to one judge, compare several judges on identical pairs.
blocks.zh: 在表5的一行之外,对主审法官的评价应该在解释错误之前将一对法官与一对法官分开,报告每个法官的设定和编码规则,在将财产分配给一名法官时,将几名法官进行比较。

blocks.en: 7.3 Binary-panel expectations on graded panels
blocks.zh: 7.3 二进制小组的期望

blocks.en: Several expectations formed on the two binary panels did not hold on the graded panels, and others held only in narrower forms (Table L1 ). The direction of Jev’s errors, for instance, reverses between the two kinds of panel (Section 5.4 ), and Jev Choice, which never chose CANNOT_ASSESS on the binary panels, abstained on 28 graded pairs. Besides the scale, the two binary panels share checklist criteria (question-specific presence checks on RiceChem, consensus behaviour checks on HealthBench), expert labels, and one wording of the abstain option. Because the graded panels also change the domain and the options and instruction that Jev receives, we attribute no failure to scale type alone.
blocks.zh: 对两个二进制小组形成的若干期望没有坚持分级小组,其他小组则只以较窄的形式举行(表L1)。 例如,Jev的错误方向在两种面板(第5.4节)和Jev Choice之间颠倒,后者从未选择过CANNOT_ 在二进制面板上的ASSESS 在28个等级对上弃权. 除了比例表之外,两个二进制小组还共享清单标准(对RiceChem进行特定存在检查、对Health Bench进行协商一致的行为检查)、专家标签和弃权方案的一个措辞。 由于分级的面板也会改变Jev收到的域以及选项和指令,因此我们不认为单打字失败.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: On binary checklist criteria Jev Choice ranked first of the matched judges on RiceChem and second on HealthBench, at a small fraction of any LLM judge’s cost and time. On graded criteria it trailed the best LLM judge on every panel, significantly on several, so there its value depends on which LLM judge it replaces.
blocks.zh: 在二进制核对表标准上,Jev Choice在RiceChem上排名第一,在Health Bench上排名第二,只占任何LLM法官成本和时间的一小部分。 在分级标准方面,它在每个小组中排名最佳的LLM评委,在几个小组中排名相当重要,因此,它的价值取决于它选择哪一个LLM评委。

blocks.en: On graded panels the matched judges departed from the labels together, mostly by placing units lower than the raters. Conventions missing from our criterion texts would explain this, as would shared training priors or the wording of our rubric versions, and our data cannot tell these apart. Jev’s confidence picked out its likelier errors on most graded panels, yet correlated errors left a cascade little to gain. With cross-fitted thresholds the replayed cascades saved cost, improved on the best single judge by at most 1.5 points, and on six panels fell below it.
blocks.zh: 在分级板上,配对的法官一起离开标签,主要是将单位比评分低。 我们标准文本中缺失的公约将对此作出解释,共享培训前科或我们标题版本的措辞也是如此,我们的数据无法加以区分。 Jev的自信在大多数分级板上挑出比较相似的错误, 采用跨适应阈值后,重播的级联节省了费用,在最佳的单人评委上提升了最多1.5分,在六个板块上跌落到低点。

blocks.en: For building rubric judges, these results favour testing changes to what judges are told, such as exemplars or level descriptions that name observable features, before adding judges given the same text. For evaluating them, each judge’s offset and agreement with other judges belong beside its agreement with the labels, and a cascade or jury should be reported with how often its members repeat one another’s errors.
blocks.zh: 就构建标点法官而言,这些结果有利于在增加法官之前,先测试法官被告知的内容的改动,例如实例或级别描述,以命名可观察到的特征。 为了评估这些错误,每位法官的抵消和与其他法官的协议除了与标签一致外,还应报告级联或陪审团,其成员之间经常重复错误。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: No experiment supplied exemplars or rewrote level descriptions. The account could be tested by rerunning ELLIPSE with exemplar essays for each level and with a grammar scale that names observable features and drops the native-like label for level 5, and by rerunning every graded panel with its benchmark’s own instructions to raters in place of our rubric version. The candidate conventions came from inspecting the judges’ errors (Section 5.4 ), and the cross-panel aggregations of Sections 5 and 6 were computed after the offset had been observed. Because none of the four judges’ vendors discloses the training data, priors that the judges share cannot be ruled out.
blocks.zh: 没有提供实验实例或重写级别描述. 帐号可以通过重新运行 ELLIPSE 来测试, 重新运行每个关卡的示例散文, 并使用语法尺度来命名可观测的特性, 并降低第5关的类似本地的标签, 并且重新运行每个分级面板, 并使用它自己的基准指示来代替我们的粗略版本 。 候选惯例来自检查法官的错误(第5.4节),第5和第6款的跨小组汇总是在看到抵消后计算的。 由于四个法官的供应商都没有披露培训数据,因此不能排除法官分享的数据。

blocks.en: The LLM judges are flash-tier models with the harness’s default prompt, used zero-shot, and Luna runs at its enforced temperature (Section 3.2 ). This matches the question of replacing the harness’s LLM call with Jev but does not measure the best obtainable LLM judge. No larger model, few-shot prompt, graded wrapper for Jev, or LLM run without the prompt’s instructions on middle levels and self-contradiction was tried, and Jev Choice was not run without the NA option. The judges also receive different instructions and option orders (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ). Jev receives a unit’s criteria together in a single request, and we did not test whether the questions of one request influence one another’s answers.
blocks.zh: LLM评委是闪光级的模型,其导带默认的速率,使用零射,而Luna运行的温度是强制的(第3.2节)。 这与用Jev取代LLM电话的问题相吻合, 没有更大的型号,几发即时,Jev的分级包装,或者LLM运行时没有在中层的project指示,并且自相矛盾被尝试,Jev Choice运行时没有NA选项. 法官还收到不同的指令和选择令(第3.1和3.2节)。 Jev在一个单一的请求中共同收到一个单元的标准,我们没有测试一个请求的问题是否影响对方的答复。

blocks.en: The main runs judged each graded panel once. Jev and Luna, the two judges run more than once, are not deterministic. Across five passes over RiceChem, about 3% of Jev’s pairs flipped verdict at least once, and in a spot check of 82 graded pairs two Luna runs gave the same verdict on 71 (Appendix A ). Jev was not rerun on a graded panel, and Gemini and DeepSeek were never run a second time. DeepSeek’s calls were also spread over several upstream providers.
blocks.zh: 主运行判断每个分级的面板一次. Jev和Luna,两位法官不止跑一次,不是决定性的。 大约3%的Jev夫妇至少翻过一次裁决, 在82级对双的现场检查中, Jev没有在分级的面板上重新运行,双子座和DeepSeek从未第二次运行. Depseek的电话也分布在几个上游供应商。

blocks.en: Per-criterion results rest on 25 to 258 units, because the graded panels are 10% or 20% samples. Two results rest on very little data. Jev Choice answered only 8 error_recovery pairs, and the _nofact result comes from three contexts. The confident-error sample takes only 12 errors from each graded panel, whereas the band analysis of Figure 4 b uses every error.
blocks.zh: 每条标值结果在25至258个单元上,因为分级板为10%或20%的样本. 两项结果依赖于极少的数据。 Jev Choice 仅回答 8 个错误_ recovery pairs,而_nact结果来自三个上下文. 图4b的波段分析使用每个错误。

blocks.en: The main intervals resample units, not the larger sampling groups, and Section 4.1 reports what changes when the groups are resampled instead. The 5-point equivalence margin is post hoc (Section 3.5 ), and because it is absolute it is lenient where accuracy is low, as on ELLIPSE. The criteria singled out in the confidence analysis and the cut-offs of Section 5.2 were chosen after inspecting the data. The location analysis of Section 5.3 is leave-one-out, but its one-level ELLIPSE shift and the USR shift of Section 5.4 were chosen on the pairs they are scored on. Cascade gains under oracle thresholds are optimistic, the cross-fitted estimates rest on halves as small as 12 units, cascade costs are linear estimates, and only deferral on the confidence of Jev Choice or Jev Noul was tried.
blocks.zh: 主要间隔重采单位,而非较大的采样组,第4.1节报告了重采组时的变化。 5点等值比值是临时的(第3.5节),由于绝对值,在准确度低的情况下,比照ELLIPSE,则宽大一些。 第5.2节的置信性分析和截断中选定的标准是在检查数据后选定的。 第5.3节的定位分析为一停,但其单级ELLIPSE转向和5.4节的USR转向被选在他们的得分对上. 甲骨文阈值下的连带收益是乐观的,交叉搭配的估计数停留在小到12个单位的一半上,级联成本是线性估计,只有Jev Choice或Jev Noul的置信度被试.

blocks.en: Nearly half of the ELLIPSE labels depend on the rounding rule (Section 3.4 ). Our rubric versions depart from the benchmarks’ own questions and rubrics (Section 3.3 ), and we compared them with what the raters read for ELLIPSE alone. On the other six graded panels a convention that our texts omit may be stated in the raters’ own instructions. The HelpSteer2 and LFQA labels partly reflect something other than the named criterion. HelpSteer2 correctness tracks overall helpfulness at Pearson r = 0.94 r=0.94 , and provenance alone predicts LFQA labels about as well as the judges do on exact accuracy. A judge may also have seen the items or labels of these public benchmarks in training.
blocks.zh: ELLIPSE标签的近一半取决于四舍五入的规则(第3.4节)。 我们的标语版本与基准本身的问题和标语(第3.3节)不同,我们将它们与仅对ELLIPSE的评分读数相比较。 在另外六个分级的板块上,我们的案文省略的公约可以在评分员自己的指示中说明。 HelpSteer2和LFQA标签部分反映了命名标准以外的东西. 帮助 指导2正确性跟踪Pearson r = 0.94 r = 0.94的总有用性,仅来源就预测了LFQA的标签,以及评委们对准确准确性的预测. 法官可能在培训中看到这些公共基准的物品或标签。

blocks.en: We tested one typed classifier. Later calls under the same model names may return different verdicts, because no judge was called by a dated model version (Sections 3.1 and 3.2 ). The graded panels are all English, four of the seven are dialogue, and the longest graded unit is 1,114 words. Prices are list or billed prices on one date, and the LLM judges’ cost depends on reasoning defaults that providers can change.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了一个打字机 后来,根据同一模式名称发出的呼吁可能退回不同的判决,因为没有一个法官被日期已晚的模式版本传唤(第3.1和3.2节)。 分级板全部为英语,7个中4个为对话,最长的分级单元为1,114字. 价格是单日的列表或计费价格,LLM评委的成本取决于提供者可以改变的推理默认.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This study uses public benchmarks as their authors released them and collects no new human-subject data. HealthBench’s health-related conversations serve only as evaluation material. We report every judge’s cost from recorded token usage and list or billed prices (Appendix B ). The authors are not incentivized by TypeSafe, which develops Jev, or by its industry competitors. We release the verdict records of every judge so that the paper’s numbers can be recomputed without calling any model API, and Appendix M lists the records and the values that need other inputs.
blocks.zh: 这项研究使用了公共基准,因为作者发布了这些基准,没有收集新的人主体数据。 Health Bench与健康有关的谈话只是作为评价材料。 我们从记录的象征性使用和清单或计费价格(附录B)中报告每位法官的费用。 作者们没有受到开发Jev的TypeSafe或其行业竞争者的奖励. 我们公布每位法官的判决记录,这样就可以在不调用任何模型API的情况下重算论文的数字,附录M列出需要其他投入的记录和价值.

blocks.en: Appendix A Panels, Judges, and Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录A 小组、法官和议定书

Rater reference (Section 3.4 ): pooled exact accuracy (%) and mean QWK. Unit words: whitespace words in the submission; RiceChem’s result files do not hold the submissions, and HealthBench’s record completion length in characters only. HealthBench’s 406 pairs by theme: hedging 108, context seeking 66, health data tasks 60, communication 54, emergency referrals 50, complex responses 38, global health 30; its units by number of criteria: one 30, two 134, three 36.
