blocks.en: Table A2: What each judge receives. {requirement} is the criterion text, verbatim. D MET D_{\text{MET}} = “The thing described in the criterion IS present in the submission”; D UNMET D_{\text{UNMET}} = “The thing described in the criterion IS NOT present in the submission”; D CA D_{\text{CA}} = “Insufficient evidence to determine either way (use rarely)”. Jev’s definitions are copied verbatim from the harness’s binary system prompt; every criterion has positive weight, so the harness’s definitions for negative criteria were never used. The wrapper of Section 3.1 is the Jev Noul instruction with D MET D_{\text{MET}} and D UNMET D_{\text{UNMET}} . The LLM judges’ model identifiers, as their APIs report them, are gpt-5.6-luna , gemini-3.8-flash , and deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash .
blocks.zh: 表A2:每个法官都得到什么。 {要求}是标准文本,逐字记录。 D MET D_{\text{MET}} = “提交材料中标准IS中描述的事物”; DUNMET D_{\text{UNMET}} = “提交材料中不存在标准中描述的事物”; DCA D_{\text{CA}} = “没有足够的证据确定其中一种方法(很少使用)”。 Jev的定义是逐字复制的,从牵引装置的二进制系统即刻得到;每个标准都有正面的分量,因此牵引装置对负面标准的定义从未使用过. 第3.1节的包装是Jev Noul指令,与DMET D_{\text{MET}}和DUNMET D_{\text{UNMET}}. LLM评委的模型识别器,如他们的API报告的那样,是gpt-5.6-luna,gemini-3.8-flash,以及 deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash.

blocks.en: Each graded panel was drawn with seed 20260919 by proportional allocation over the strata of Table A1 and written to disk before any judge was called. Sampling units are kept whole. The four answers to an LFQA question, the responses to one USR context, and the two responses of a HelpSteer2 preference pair enter the sample together. LFQA and the two USR panels have no strata and are simple random samples of questions or contexts. Section 3.3 gives the RiceChem split and the size of the HealthBench panel. HealthBench’s completions were stratified by theme and by whether the labels of a completion’s criteria are all MET, mixed, or all UNMET.
blocks.zh: 每个分级板通过表A1层的按比例分配抽取20260919种子,并在任何裁判被传唤前写成磁盘. 抽样单元保持完整。 对一个LFQA问题的4个答案,对一个USR上下文的答案,以及HelpSteer2偏好配对的两个答案一起输入样本. LFQA和两个USR面板没有分层,是简单随机抽取的问题或背景. 第3.3节给出了水稻Chem分块和Health Bench面板的大小. Health Bench的完成按主题和完成标准的标签是否全部是MET、混合的或所有UNMET的分类。

blocks.en: The protection against label leakage is structural. The harness passes a judge only a unit’s input and its submission, and Jev’s state contains only these two fields. Human labels are stored apart from the units, and holistic scores, strata, and the identity of the system that produced a unit sit in a description field that no judge receives. No graded panel has a reference submission. HealthBench’s physician-written ideal completion is removed from every judge’s input, except in one Jev ablation that lies outside the protocol (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 防止标签泄漏是结构性的。 Jev的状态只包含这两个字段。 人类的标签与单位分开储存,整体的分数,层层,以及产生单位的系统的身份,坐落在一个没有法官接受的描述字段. 没有分级小组提交参考材料。 健康本奇的医生写作的理想完成从每位法官的输入中被删除,除了在协议外的一次Jev衰竭(附录D).

blocks.en: Every judge receives the criterion and option strings of the rubric versions described in Section 3.3 . A FED question recast as a statement reads “To the average person, the response is interesting.” The typographic artifacts that the ELLIPSE level descriptions keep from the corpus’s rubric include “capitalizatio n” and “inappropri ately”. Every criterion of the graded panels carries the same weight.
blocks.zh: 每个法官都得到第3.3节所述标题版本的标准和选择字符串。 一个FED问题重写为“对普通人来说,答复很有趣。” ELLIPSE级描述所保留与该实体名称无关的印刷文物包括 " capitizatio n " 和 " 不当食用 " 。 分级面板的每一项标准都具有相同的重量。

blocks.en: Ratings of N/A are dropped before the mean is taken. This affects FED-Dialogue error_recovery (Appendix F ) and one FED-Turn fluent pair, whose label rests on four raters. Half-way means are kept, and Table A1 counts them. ELLIPSE labels average the two raters’ individual scores, and the benchmark’s released score is not used. An embedded binary criterion takes the rater majority. A tie would have removed the pair, and none occurred.
blocks.zh: 在采用平均值之前,取消对非/A的评级。 这影响了FED-Dialogue错误_ recovery(Appendix F)和一对FED-Turn流线双子,其标签以4个评分计. 半程手段被保留,表A1计算它们. ELLIPSE的标签平均为两个评分者的个人分数,而基准发布的分数不使用. 嵌入式二进制标准取评分多数. 一条领带会拆掉双胞胎,没有发生。

blocks.en: The rater reference of Section 3.4 uses the metric functions applied to the judges and pools over units with at least two raters. Each rater on a binary criterion is compared with the majority of the others, and ties are skipped. Panel exact accuracy pools the graded criteria in proportion to their rater comparisons, and panel QWK is mean QWK as defined in Section 3.5 . The smaller target of Section 3.4 matters most when a unit has few raters, since with three raters it is the mean of two ratings. With three raters per unit on the USR panels, the reference is 100.0% on unanimous pairs and 34.4% (USR-TC) or 42.0% (USR-PC) on split pairs, so its value is set largely by the share of unanimous pairs. Of the leave-one-out factuality targets on LFQA, 48.3% are half-way means of two ratings and round up, whereas no three-rater label on LFQA is half-way. Label uncertainty of this kind can distort any comparison with human agreement ( Elangovan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 第3.4节的评分法参考了适用于法官和至少有两个评分法的单位的评分法。 二进制标准的每个评分器都与大多数其他评分相比,而联系被跳过. 小组准确无误地将分级标准集合在一起,按其评分比较的比例,小组QWK是第3.5节所界定的平均QWK。 第3.4节的较小目标在单位没有评级的情况下最为重要,因为有三个评级是两个评级的平均值。 USR面板上每个单元有3个评分器,在一致配对上参考率为100.0%,在分对上参考率为34.4%(USR-TC)或42.0%(USR-PC),因此其值主要由一致配对的比例来设定. 在LFQA上的一停即止的实际情况目标中,48.3%是两个收视率和总和的半途制,而LFQA上没有三个分数的标签是半途制. 这种标签的不确定性可能扭曲与人类协议的任何比较(Elangovan等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: All three LLM judges are called through LiteLLM. Each runs as a single judge in the harness, with a strict JSON response schema and no few-shot examples. No reasoning or thinking parameter was sent. On the graded panels Luna emitted 337,696 reasoning tokens, Gemini 2,556,073, and DeepSeek 3,046,094. Luna’s count includes the first run of the spot check described below, which shared the response cache. The shuffle of Section 3.2 draws from a generator seeded with the logged per-run seed, the submission, the criterion index, and the judge. It moves the NA option with the others, and the chosen option is mapped back to its level. The response cache was on. Twelve of Luna’s embedded binary verdicts were served from that spot check’s cached responses, and every other recorded verdict comes from a single pass over its panel.
blocks.zh: 所有三名LLM评委都通过LiteLLM调用. 每一个都以一个法官的身份运行在拉带中,有一个严格的JSON响应计划,没有几个镜头的例子. 没有发送推理或思维参数 。 在分级板上,Luna发射了337,696个推理符,双子座2,556,073个和DeepSeek3,046,094个. Luna的计数包括以下描述的首次抽查,该抽查共享了响应缓存. 第3.2节的洗涤取自一台发电机,其种子有记录的每支种子、提交材料、标准指数和法官。 它将NA选项与其他选项一起移动,所选择的选项被映射回其水平. 反应缓存打开了。 Luna的12个嵌入式二进制判决都来自现场检查的缓存反应,

blocks.en: The multi-choice system prompt that Section 3.2 summarizes reads, in part, “Pay careful attention to negation, scope, and qualifying language”, “Be strict about factual accuracy but flexible about wording”, and “Do not default to middle options out of uncertainty”. Its rule for self-contradictory submissions (Section 3.2 ) reads “select the option reflecting the weaker (lower-quality) reading”. It reserves the NA option for submissions that point to inaccessible content, cannot be judged on the question, or are too garbled to evaluate, and it tells the judge not to choose NA when it is uncertain but has some evidence.
blocks.zh: 多选择制度促使第3.2节部分概括如下:“谨慎注意否定性、范围和限定性语言”、“严格注重事实准确性,但措辞灵活”和“不因不确定性而默认中间选择”。 它对自相矛盾的呈文的规则(第3.2节)是“选择反映较弱(质量较低的)读数的选择”。 它保留NA选项,用于指向无法访问的内容,无法对问题作出判断,或过于拘泥于评价,它告诉法官在不确定但有证据的情况下不要选择NA.

blocks.en: OpenRouter’s default routing spread DeepSeek’s graded-panel calls over 11 upstream providers. DeepSeek returned an empty response on six graded pairs (four on ELLIPSE, one on HelpSteer2, and one on LFQA), which are excluded from every graded metric. It did the same on one RiceChem pair and two HealthBench pairs, the three binary-panel failures of Section 3.5 , which the harness did not flag (Table F1 ). No Jev request failed.
blocks.zh: OpenRouter的默认路线将DeepSeek分级的小组电话传播到11个上游供应商。 DeepSeek在6个等级对上(ELLIPSE上4个,HelpSteer2上1个,LFQA上1个)还原了一个空响应,它们被排除在每个等级的度量中. 它对一对RiceChem和两对Health Bench也做了同样的事情,这两对Health Bench是第3.5节的三个二进制-小板故障,而吊带没有标注(表F1)。 没有 Jev 请求失败 。

blocks.en: The two fields of Jev’s state (Section 3.1 ) are named input and submission , after the harness’s tags. The input is the unit’s context. It is the preceding conversation on FED-Turn and HealthBench, the conversation with the fact or persona the response is conditioned on for the USR panels, the user’s prompt on HelpSteer2, the question on LFQA and RiceChem, and the title of the essay prompt on ELLIPSE. On FED-Dialogue it is the fixed sentence “A conversation between a User and a System.” Unlike the LLM judges, Jev does not receive the criterion type.
blocks.zh: Jev状态的两个领域(第3.1节)以吊带标签命名输入和提交。 输入是单位的背景。 在FED-Turn和Health Bench上的对话, 与事实或人物的对话, 在FED-对话中,是固定句子“用户与系统的对话”。 与LLM评委不同,Jev没有获得标准类型.

blocks.en: Five interleaved passes over the RiceChem panel and a 59-pair HealthBench subset, under all three binary framings, used 2,250 requests. They were made on the day of the judging runs (Section 3.1 ), and every one of them reports jev-1.13.0 . On RiceChem, 2.9% of pairs changed verdict at least once under Jev Noul and 3.3% under Jev Choice. Under every framing, each change occurred on a pair whose mean probability of MET lay within 0.1 of 0.5 (Figure D1 b shows Jev Noul). The standard deviation of accuracy across passes was 0.36 points for Jev Noul on RiceChem, 0.76 points on the HealthBench subset, and at most 0.93 points for any framing. The share of pairs with identical probabilities in all five passes ranged from 4.2% of RiceChem pairs under bare Noul to 35.8% under Jev Choice. The median request latency was 0.18 to 0.20 seconds in every pass.
blocks.zh: 5个互页通过RiceChem面板和一个59-pair Health Bench子集,在所有三个二进制框架下,使用了2 250项请求。 他们都是在审判日(第3.1节)进行的,他们都报告说是jev-1.13.0。 在RiceChem上,2.9%的对子在Jev Noul下至少改变一次判决,在Jev Choice下改变3.3%。 在每个框架下,每个变化都发生在一个对子上,该对子的MET平均概率在0.1到0.5之间(图D1b显示Jev Noul)。 Jev Noul在RiceChem上的准确度标准差为0.36分,Health Bench子集的精确度标准差为0.76分,任何框架的精确度最高为0.93分。 所有5个通行证中概率相同的对子的比例从赤裸努尔下的4.2%的米饭Chem对到杰夫选择下的35.8%不等. 每经0.18至0.20秒的中位请求延迟.

blocks.en: In a spot check before the reported runs, Luna judged 82 pairs twice, all the pairs of two units from each graded panel, the second time with the response cache bypassed. The two runs agreed on 71 of the 82 pairs (86.6%). The reported Luna run is a later, separate pass and was not compared with either.
blocks.zh: 在报告运行前的一次抽查中,Luna两次判断了82对,每个分级面板上所有2对单元的对子,第二次有响应缓存绕过. 两人同意82对中的71对(86.6%). 报道的月球运行是后期,单独通过,也没有与两者相比.

blocks.en: Appendix B Cost and Wall Time
blocks.zh: 附录B 费用和墙壁时间

blocks.en: Table B1: Cost and wall time per panel and judge. Concurrency: Jev 8 on every panel; Luna 16, Gemini 20, and DeepSeek 32 on the graded panels; every judge 8 on the binary panels. DeepSeek: billed cost (Section 3.5 ) and, in the last column, the harness’s estimate for the same calls, with its ratio given only for the total. a Seven graded panels only; Jev Score was not run on the binary panels. Jev’s bare Noul and Jev Noul costs on the binary panels are in Table D1 , and judge-call failures in Table F1 . Prices are those of the run date.
blocks.zh: 表B1:每个分庭和法官的费用和墙壁时间。 货币:每个面板为Jev 8;双子座16,双子座20,分级面板为DeepSeek 32;二子面板为每个法官8. DeepSeek:开具账单的费用(第3.5节),在最后一栏中,电源对同一电话的估算,其比率只给出了总数。 a 仅七个等级的面板;Jev Score没有在二进制面板上运行。 Jev在二进制面板上的赤裸裸的Noul和Jev Noul费用见表D1,在表F1中的法官召唤失败。 价格为运行日期的价格.

blocks.en: Section 3.5 gives the cost rule behind Table B1 . Jev’s cost is the input-token count that the API reported for each request, at the price of Section 3.1 . Luna’s and Gemini’s costs are LiteLLM’s completion cost, computed for each call from the token counts the API reported, reasoning tokens included. Gemini’s recorded cost is reproduced exactly by $0.75 per million prompt tokens and $3.75 per million completion tokens, and its prompt-token price is about 18 times Jev’s. A response served from the cache carries the cost of its original call. Over the seven graded panels Jev Choice and Jev Score cost about the same, $0.043 and $0.042.
blocks.zh: 第3.5节规定了表B1后面的费用规则。 Jev的费用是API按3.1节的价格为每项请求报告的输入式计算。 Luna和双子座的成本是LiteLLM的完成成本, 双子座的纪录成本精确地重现了每百万个即时纪念币的75美元和每百万个完成纪念币的375美元,其即时纪念币的价格是Jev的18倍。 从缓存得到的答复包含其最初通话的费用。 在7个分级小组中,Jev Choice和Jev分数的费用大约相同,分别为0.043美元和0.042美元。

blocks.en: A panel’s billed cost sums the costs that OpenRouter reported with each response. The harness’s own estimate applies one list price to every call, whichever upstream provider served it, and it is lower (Table B1 , last column). The billed cost is 1.36 times the estimate on RiceChem and 1.23 times on HealthBench. On single graded panels the factor runs from 1.31 to 1.46, and it is 1.34 over the seven together. The billed totals exclude the six failed graded calls and the three failed binary calls, which left no cached response.
blocks.zh: 一个小组的账单将OpenRouter每次答复时报告的费用相加。 电源本身的估算对每一次呼叫都采用一个列表价格,无论哪个上游供应商为它服务,而且价格较低(表B1,最后一栏)。 计费费用是RiceChem的1.36倍和Health Bench的1.23倍。 在单级面板上,因数从1.31至1.46,共7个比1.34。 计费总额排除了6个分级失败的呼叫和3个二进制失败的呼叫,没有留下缓存的响应.

blocks.en: Among Gemini’s ratios, RiceChem is the exception to the order described in Section 4.2 . With 6.8 criteria per unit, its ratio (326 × \times ) is below those of ELLIPSE and both USR panels, which have fewer. Unit length has little effect. ELLIPSE’s essays are the longest graded units and the USR responses among the shortest (Table A1 ), yet with one criterion per unit more, ELLIPSE’s ratio (396 × \times ) is close to the USR panels’ (373 × \times and 349 × \times ). Among Luna’s ratios, ELLIPSE’s (29 × \times ) is below HelpSteer2’s (33 × \times ), although HelpSteer2 has fewer criteria per unit.
blocks.zh: 在双子座比例中,稻米 Chem是第4.2节所述顺序的例外。 以每单位6.8个标准计算,其比率(326×\时)低于ELLIPSE和两个USR面板,两者都较少. 单位长度影响不大. ELLIPSE的散文是分级时间最长的单位和最短的USR(表A1)中的反应,然而,每单位多一个标准,ELLIPSE的比例(396×\时)接近USR小组(373×时和349×时). 在Luna的比例中,ELLIPSE的(29×\时)低于HelpSteer2的(33×\时),尽管HelpSteer2的单位标准较少.

blocks.en: Completion tokens, which include reasoning tokens, make up most of Gemini’s bill on ELLIPSE, $6.66 of $9.46 (70.4%), and 47.8% of its $1.64 on FED-Turn.
blocks.zh: 包括推理信使在内的完成信使构成双子座关于ELLIPSE的大部分账单,9.46美元(70.4%)的6.66美元和FED-Turn的1.64美元的47.8%.

blocks.en: Wall time is measured around each panel’s evaluation and includes checkpoint writes. On the graded panels each judge ran in its own process, and the three LLM processes ran simultaneously, each against its own provider (Section 4.2 describes Jev’s two processes). On each binary panel the LLM judges ran one after another, Luna first and DeepSeek last. The RiceChem and HealthBench runs proceeded simultaneously and called the same providers in the same order, so their LLM wall times are not isolated measurements. Jev’s binary framings ran one after another in a single process.
blocks.zh: 墙壁时间由每个面板的评价量度,并包括检查站的文字。 在分级小组中,每位法官在自己的过程中运行,三个LLM过程同时运行,每个过程都与自己的提供者相对应(第4.2节描述了Jev的两个过程)。 在每一个二进制板上,LLM评委逐一跑,Luna先跑,DeepSeek最后跑. RiceChem和Health Bench的运行同时进行,并按同样的顺序称同一供应商,因此它们的LLM壁时间并不是孤立的测量. Jev的二进制框架在一个单一的进程中逐一运行。

blocks.en: Appendix C Paired Comparisons and Secondary Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录C 比较和中等教育

blocks.en: Section 4.1 rests on the unit-level comparisons of Table C1 . Table C2 adds every pair-level sign test, and Table C3 gives secondary metrics for the graded panels.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节依据的是表C1的单位一级比较。 表C2增加了每对级标志测试,表C3给出了分级面板的二级度量.

blocks.en: Table C1: Paired comparisons with units resampled (Section 3.5 ). Diff: the second judge’s accuracy minus Jev Choice’s, in points, on the pairs both scored; on the graded panels the upper block includes the embedded binary pairs (Section 3.1 ), and the lower block uses ordinal pairs only. 95% interval: percentile interval over 10,000 resamples of units. Bound: the smallest symmetric margin, in points, that contains the 90% interval. J : O: units on which Jev Choice is ahead against units on which the other judge is ahead, and p unit p_{\text{unit}} the exact two-sided sign test over them, with tied units set aside. Class: separated (Section 3.5 ), parity (Section 3.5 ), both, or neither (–). Parity needs a bound below 5 points, so USR-PC Jev Score, with a bound of exactly 5.0, is not at parity. ‡: the bootstrap p p -value survives Holm correction within its block of 27 or 7 comparisons.

blocks.en: Table C2: Every pair-level sign test. These tests treat pairs as independent, and Table C1 gives the unit-level comparisons of Jev Choice. n n is the number of pairs both judges scored. The Jev column counts the pairs only the Jev framing got right, and the LLM column the pairs only the other judge got right; p p is the exact two-sided binomial test on these two counts. Left: Jev Choice against each LLM judge, with Holm-adjusted p p over these 27 tests. Right: Jev Noul against each LLM judge on the binary panels, and Jev Score against each LLM judge on ordinal pairs. Bottom: Jev Choice against Jev Score on ordinal pairs.
blocks.zh: 表 C2:每对级标志测试. 这些测试将配对视为独立,表C1给出了Jev Choice的单位级比较. n是两个评委得分的对数。 Jev栏只计算Jev框架得到的对数,而LLM栏只计算其他法官得到的对数;p是这两个项的精确双面二元测试. 左:Jev 选择对每一个LLM裁判, 由Holm 调整 p 在这27个测试。 对: Jev Noul在二进制板上对每个LLM裁判,Jev Score在正数对上对每一个LLM裁判. 底部:Jev Choice 逆Jev积分对正数对.

blocks.en: Table C3: Secondary metrics on the graded panels. (a) and (b) are computed on ordinal pairs. (c) HelpSteer2’s single released label serves as its rater mean, so its row repeats the offsets against the label. (d) Correlation over units between the holistic score (ELLIPSE overall score, FED and USR overall ratings, HelpSteer2 helpfulness, and LFQA acceptability) and the harness’s unit aggregate, the mean of option values over a unit’s criteria. (e) Predicted level and rater mean are both scaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] within each criterion. (f) The Jev Choice and Jev Score rows are Jev Noul verdicts from two separate requests. (g) The other judges’ values are in Table 2 . Rater reference: as in Section 3.4 and, for (f), Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 表C3:分级面板上的二级指标。 (a)和(b)按正数对计算。 (c) HelpSteer2的单发标签是它的评分值,因此其行重复了对标签的抵消。 (d) 整体得分(ELLIPSE总得分、FED和USR总得分、HelpSteer2的帮助和LFQA的可接受性)与Up的单位总和(选择值的平均值高于单位的标准)之间的关联。 (e) 预估水平和平均评分率均在每项标准内分别调整为[0、1][0、1]。 (f) Jev Choice和Jev积分排是Jev Noul对两个不同请求的判决。 (g) 其他法官的数值见表2。 参考鼠标:如第3.4节和(f)附录A。

blocks.en: Each comparison of Table C1 draws its resamples from its own seeded generator. The bootstrap intervals separate as many of the 27 comparisons as the uncorrected pair-level tests do, four in each direction, and seven of the eight separations coincide. The exception is Gemini’s pair-level lead on FED-Turn ( p = 0.032 p=0.032 ), which the intervals do not separate. Of its 75 turns, 17 favour Jev Choice, 25 favour Gemini, and 33 are tied ( p unit = 0.28 p_{\text{unit}}=0.28 ). The intervals separate Luna’s lead on USR-PC instead, whose pair-level p p is 0.10. The unit sign test is significant in six comparisons, three in each direction, and after Holm correction it keeps the same three as the pair-level test. It does not separate two comparisons with Luna that the intervals separate, Jev Choice’s lead on HealthBench ( p unit = 0.059 p_{\text{unit}}=0.059 ) and Luna’s lead on USR-PC ( p unit = 0.11 p_{\text{unit}}=0.11 ).
blocks.zh: 表C1的每次比较都从自己的种子生成器中提取其复标. 靴子间隔与未校正的对等测试一样,在27个比较中分离,每个方向4个,8个分离中的7个吻合. 例外的是双子座的双层铅在FED-Turn(p = 0.032 p = 0.032)上,间隔不分离. 在它的75个转弯中,17个偏爱Jev Choice,25个偏爱双子座,33个被捆绑(p单位=0.28 p_{\text{unit}}=0.28 ). Luna的铅在USR-PC上分开, 单位标志测试在6个比较中意义显著,每个方向3个,霍尔姆修正后保持与对位测试相同的3个. 与Luna的间隔是分开的, Jev Choice在Health Bench上的领先(p单位=0.059 p_{\text{unit}}=0.059)和Luna在USR-PC上的领先(p单位=0.11 p_{\text{unit}}=0.11).

blocks.en: Over 2,000 resamples of ELLIPSE’s essays, the marginal 95% interval of exact accuracy is 11.5% to 15.3% for Jev Choice and 27.0% to 32.8% for Gemini.
blocks.zh: 超过2000份ELLIPSE的散文复制品,精确度的95%的边际间距是Jev Choice的11.5%至15.3%,双子座的27.0%至32.8%。

blocks.en: Parity holds with Luna on ELLIPSE, FED-Turn, and USR-TC; with DeepSeek on RiceChem, HealthBench, ELLIPSE, and USR-PC; and with Gemini on LFQA. The bound of Table C1 has a median of 5.9 points and is at most 7.5 points for 21 of the 27 comparisons. Three of these 21 are also separated, so at a 7.5-point margin they would be both equivalent and separated.
blocks.zh: 在ELLIPSE、FED-Turn和USR-TC上与Luna持平;在RiceChem、Health Bench、ELLIPSE和USR-PC上与DeepSeek持平;在LFQA上与双子座持平。 表C1的中位数为5.9点,27个比较中的21个最多为7.5点。 这21个国家中有3个也是分开的,因此,在7.5点的比值上,它们既是相等的也是分开的。

blocks.en: The sampling groups are the 45 HelpSteer2 prompts, the 30 LFQA questions, and the 12 contexts of each USR panel. Resampling them in place of units widens nine of the twelve intervals with an LLM judge on these panels and changes the four outcomes listed in Section 4.1 . USR-TC Luna and LFQA Gemini have bounds of 5.3 and 5.1 points. Luna’s USR-PC interval runs from − 0.3 -0.3 to + 8.7 +8.7 points, and LFQA DeepSeek’s from − 6.5 -6.5 to − 0.6 -0.6 . Of the separations that result, the three in an LLM judge’s favour are all Gemini’s. With 12 to 45 groups these percentile intervals are rough.
blocks.zh: 抽样组是45个帮助Steer2提示,30个低限质量问题,以及每个USR小组的12个背景。 取而代之的是12个单元中的9个单元,在这些小组中有一名LLM法官,并改变第4.1节所列的4个结果。 USR-TC Luna和LFQA双子体的界限为5.3和5.1分。 Luna的USR-PC间隔从−0.3-0.3到+8.7+8.7分,LFQA DeepSeek的间隔从−6.5-6.5到−0.6-0.6. 3位LLM法官都支持双子座。 有12至45个群体,这些百分位间隔很粗糙。

blocks.en: The unit sign test favours Jev Score on ELLIPSE, FED-Turn, and FED-Dialogue, and Holm correction keeps the first two. The bootstrap intervals also separate USR-TC (Section 4.3 ). The ELLIPSE difference of 1.9 points is both separated and at parity.
blocks.zh: 单位签名测试有利于Jev Score在ELLIPSE,FED-Turn,以及FED-Dialogue上,霍尔姆校正保留了前两个. 靴子间隔也分开USR-TC(第4.3节)。 ELLIPSE的1.9分之差既分离,也处于对等状态.

blocks.en: For two judges, the test counts the pairs both scored that only the first got right and those that only the second got right, and applies an exact two-sided binomial test with probability 0.5 to these discordant counts, the exact McNemar test. Jev Choice is tested on the pair sets of Table C1 . Tests involving Jev Score use ordinal pairs only, since on embedded binary pairs both graded framings are Jev Noul (Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: 对两位评委来说,测试数既计算出只有第一位获得对分的对分,也计算出只有第二位获得对分的对分,并且对这些不和的对分计数,即准确的麦克尼马尔的对分进行精确的双面二元测试,概率为0.5. Jev Choice在表C1的对组上测试. 仅涉及Jev分数使用正数配对的测试,因为在嵌入式二进制配对上,两个分级框架都是Jev Noul(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: Holm correction multiplies the i i -th smallest of the 27 p p -values of Jev Choice against an LLM judge by 28 − i 28-i , takes a running maximum, and caps the result at 1. Applied to the bootstrap p p -values, it keeps four separations (Section 4.1 ), and applied to the pair-level tests it keeps three: Gemini ahead on ELLIPSE, and Jev Choice ahead on HelpSteer2 against Luna ( p Holm = 0.011 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.011 ) and on RiceChem against Gemini ( p Holm = 0.016 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.016 ). Gemini’s FED-Dialogue lead, which survives Holm correction of the bootstrap p p -values, has a pair-level adjusted value of 0.19. The other 34 pair-level tests in Table C2 are reported without correction. Among them, Jev Score is significantly more accurate than an LLM judge in 7 of its 21 comparisons on ordinal pairs and significantly less accurate in 2, both against Gemini, on ELLIPSE and HelpSteer2. These 21 comparisons were not repeated at the unit level.
blocks.zh: Holm校正将Jev Choice对LLM法官的27 p-值中最小的i乘以28 − i 28 i,取一个运行最大值,结果上限为 1 。 应用到靴子 p -值上,它保持了4个分离(第4.1节),并应用于它保持的对等测试 3:双子超前于ELLIPSE,Jev Choice超前于HelpSteer2对月球超前(pHolm=0.011 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.011)和赖斯超前测试. Chem对双子座(pHolm = 0.016 p_{\text{Holm}}=0.016). 双子座的FED对话领先,幸存下来. Holm 校正靴子 p -值, 双级调整值为 0.19 。 表C2中的其他34个对等水平的测试报告没有更正. 其中,Jev Score在对正弦对数的21个比较中,有7个比LLM评委准确得多,2个比双子座,ELLIPSE和HelpSteer2都准确得多. 这21项比较没有在单位一级重复。

blocks.en: Measured against the unrounded rater mean, every offset outside USR-TC is negative, as it is against the rounded label, so the rounding rule does not produce the sign of the offset (Table C3 c). Jev Noul’s MET rate over the embedded binary pairs (74.2%) is close to the labels’ (74.7%), largely because two USR-TC criteria err in opposite directions, understandable with 17 false positives and uses_knowledge with 16 false negatives. The unit aggregate correlates with HelpSteer2’s helpfulness score at Spearman 0.12 to 0.27 for every judge, against 0.44 to 0.92 on the other graded panels (Table C3 d), although HelpSteer2’s correctness label alone tracks helpfulness (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 对照未四舍五入的计量率表示,USR-TC以外的每个抵消都是负的,因为它与四舍五入的标签相反,因此四舍五入规则不产生抵消的标志(表C3c). Jev Noul对嵌入式二进制配对(74.2%)的MET率接近标签(74.7%),这主要是因为两个USR-TC标准方向相反,17个假阳性可以理解,16个假阴性使用_知识。 单位汇总与HelpSteer2在Spearman 0.12至0.27的帮助得分有关,而在其他分级板上则为0.44至0.92(表C3d),尽管HelpSteer2的正确性标签仅跟踪帮助(表3)。

blocks.en: Appendix D The Binary Panels
blocks.zh: 附录D 二进制小组

blocks.en: On the full set the wrapper’s gain is 9.6 points, against 10.7 on the panel. The gain comes from false positives. Bare Noul predicts MET on 78.4% of the panel’s pairs against a labelled rate of 59.5%. The wrapper lowers the false-positive rate from 61.1% to 34.9% and leaves the false-negative rate near 10%. Per criterion on the full set, the largest gain, 43.2 points, is on the nine-word criterion “Explaining sentence 2: any additional energy becomes kinetic energy”. It states content without saying what to check, which may be why the definitions help there. Only two of the 27 criteria lose accuracy under the wrapper, by 5.0 and 2.1 points.
blocks.zh: 包装纸的收获是9.6分,而包装板的收获是10.7分。 增益来自假阳性. 赤裸 Noul预测对面板78.4%的对子进行MET预测,标注率为59.5%。 包装将假阳性率从61.1%降低到34.9%,使假阴性率接近10%. 按整套标准计算,最大的收益是43.2点,标准是“解释第2句:任何额外的能量成为动能”。 它不言而喻地说,它的内容是令人满意的,这可能是为什么定义有助于这一点。 27条标准中只有两条在包装下失去准确度,分别为5.0分和2.1分.

blocks.en: Of HealthBench’s 34 consensus criteria, the wrapper raises accuracy on 5, lowers it on 9, and leaves 20 unchanged. A 466-word context-seeking criterion of 23 pairs gains the most, rising from 39.1% to 82.6%, yet two other context-seeking criteria of similar length each lose 10.0 points. Criterion length does not predict the direction of the effect, since the criteria that lose accuracy run from 32 to 481 words. The three largest losses, of 20.0 to 30.8 points, fall on criteria of 13 or fewer pairs. The largest is on a global-health criterion that is met when the response contains no inaccuracies that could lead to harm. MET there means that something is absent, which the wrapper’s definition of MET as something “present in the submission” may not capture. Because each criterion holds only 4 to 25 pairs, these differences show only that a fixed wrapper can lower accuracy on individual criteria.
blocks.zh: 在Health Bench的34个共识标准中,包装器提高了5的精度,降低了9的精度,留下20个不变. 466字的求上下文标准为23对,得分最多,从39.1%上升到82.6%,但长度相似的另两项求上下文标准各损失10.0分. 标准长度并不预测效果的方向,因为失去准确性的标准从32到481字不等. 3个最大损失,为20.0至30.8分,低于13对或更少的标准. 最大的标准是全球卫生标准,当反应中没有任何可能导致伤害的不准确之处时,该标准就得到满足。 其中的MET意味着不存在某种东西,包装者将MET定义为 " 提交书中 " 的东西可能无法捕捉到。 由于每个标准只持有4到25对,这些差异只表明固定的包装器可以降低单个标准的准确性.

blocks.en: The Jev Noul threshold was also set, post hoc, to maximize accuracy on the 80% training portion of RiceChem. The chosen threshold, 0.58, gives 81.5% on the training portion. On the panel it gives 78.9%, below the 80.1% of the fixed threshold of 0.5.

blocks.en: The completion is not in English on 36 of HealthBench’s 406 pairs, and the criterion is in English on every pair. Jev Noul is correct on 77.8% of these pairs, against 77.3% on the English pairs. The three LLM judges are less accurate on the non-English pairs, by 7.2 points (Luna), 11.1 (Gemini), and 7.6 (DeepSeek). With 36 pairs, the standard error of each non-English accuracy is at least 6.9 points, so no single difference is established, and the common direction across the three LLM judges is suggestive only.
blocks.zh: 完成部分在健康奔驰的406对36上没有英语,标准每对都有英语. 其中77.8%的Jev Noul正确,而英国的77.3%。 三位LLM评委对非英语配对的准确度较低,分别是7.2分(Luna),11.1分(Gemini)和7.6分(DeepSeek). 有了36对,每个非英语精度的标准误差至少是6.9分,所以没有确定单一的差数,跨三个LLM评委的共同方向只有暗示性.

blocks.en: HealthBench records each physician’s label, so the binary rater reference of Appendix A can also be computed for the physicians. Over all 406 pairs this gives 98.1%, an artifact of selection. Because tied pairs never entered the pool (Section 3.4 ), all 356 two-physician pairs are unanimous, and they contribute 712 of the 838 comparisons, every one an agreement. The 50 pairs with three or more physicians, from 20 completions, are free of this selection. On them the physician reference is 87.3% (95% interval 79.7 to 93.3 over completions), with κ = 0.75 \kappa=0.75 . Against the same leave-one-out targets the judges reach 73.0% (bare Noul) to 84.1% (Jev Choice), which is 3.2 to 14.3 points below the reference. Every judge’s 95% interval for its difference reaches zero, so these pairs show only that the judges are not detectably below the physicians.
blocks.zh: Health Bench记录每个医生的标签,因此附录A的二进制评分参考书也可以为医生计算。 在所有406对中,这给了98.1%,是精选的文物。 由于捆绑的对子从未进入泳池(第3.4节),所有356对双体对子都是一致的,它们贡献了838年比较中的712对,每对都是协议. 50对配有3名或3名以上医生的,从20名毕业开始,不受此选择. 其中,医生参考率为87.3%(95%的间隔为79.7%至93.3小时),其中0.75\kappa=0.75。 根据同样的 " 一停 " 目标,法官达到73.0%(不到努尔)至84.1%(杰夫选择),低于参考点3.2至14.3点。 每个法官的95%的差值间隔都达到了零,因此这些对数只显示法官不能在医生以下检测。

blocks.en: In an ablation outside the protocol, HealthBench’s physician-written ideal completion was added to Jev Noul’s state, and accuracy rose from 77.3% to 79.1%. Because no other judge received the ideal, this result enters no comparison.
blocks.zh: 在协议外的一次退位中,健康奔驰的医生写作的理想完成率被加进了Jev Noul的状态,准确率从77.3%上升到79.1%。 由于没有其他法官获得理想,这一结果无法进行比较。

blocks.en: FED-Turn’s graded criteria have three levels. Individual raters chose the middle level, “Somewhat.”, for 26.5% of their ratings, fewer than the 32.6% of pairs that the averaged labels place there (Table E1 ). Jev Choice, Gemini, and DeepSeek use the middle level least. On correct and fluent , two criteria that state a yes-or-no property, Jev Choice never predicts “Somewhat.” in 75 pairs each.
blocks.zh: FED-Turn的分级标准有三个级别. 个人评分者选择了中间级,“Something.”评分26.5%的评分,低于平均标注的32.6%(表E1)。 Jev Choice,双子座和DeepSeek使用中层最少. Jev Choice从未预测“什么”为75对。

blocks.en: On FED-Turn, Jev Score is ahead of every matched judge in exact accuracy, within-one accuracy, mean QWK, and mean absolute error (Tables 2 and C3 ). It does not lead on offset, where Gemini’s is smallest, or on the unit aggregate’s rank correlation with the holistic score, where Jev Choice has 0.603 and Jev Score 0.597. Scored against the same leave-one-out targets as a rater, Jev Score reaches 66.3% exact accuracy and a single crowd worker 63.8% (Table E1 ).
blocks.zh: 在FED-Turn上,Jev Score在准确准确度,内在准确度,平均QWK,以及平均绝对误差(表2和C3)方面领先于每个匹配的裁判. 它不会导致双子座最小的抵消,也不会导致单位总和与整体分数的等级关系,Jev Choice拥有0.603和Jev Score 0.597。 Jev Score的精确度达到66.3%,一个人群工人达到63.8%(表E1)。

blocks.en: The bottom of Table E1 exchanges the two decoding rules on FED-Turn’s ordinal pairs, as a post-hoc analysis. Jev Choice’s probabilities over the three levels, with the NA probability removed and the rest renormalized, give 55.4% exact accuracy when read by Score’s rule, the rounded expected level. Read by argmax, as Jev Choice runs, they give 56.2%. Jev Score’s probabilities give 64.6% when read by argmax and 66.7% when read by its own expected level. Under the argmax rule, exchanging the probabilities accounts for 80% of the 10.5-point difference between the framings as run. Under the expected-value rule the share is 107%, because that rule does slightly worse than argmax on Jev Choice’s probabilities. Averaged over pairs, Jev Choice puts more probability than Jev Score on “No.” (0.316 against 0.205) and less on “Somewhat.” (0.171 against 0.210) and “Yes.” (0.513 against 0.585). Rounding the expected level half up or half to even gives the same 55.4%.

Jev Score的概率值为64.6%,如果读取agmax,则为66.7%。 根据argmax规则,交换概率占运行中框架之间10.5点差的80%. 根据预期价值规则,该份额为107%,因为该规则比Jev Choice的概率略差。 Jev Choice在“No”(0.316对0.205)和“Some what”(0.171对0.210)和“Yes”(0.513对0.585)上给出的概率均高于Jev分数。 将预期水平的半调半调甚至给予同样的55.4%。

blocks.en: The vendor documentation states that for Score ‘‘every level is evaluated separately’’ and that the model does not see a level’s number or its neighbours. It also describes Score’s levels as weak in numerical calibration. 3 3 3 https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/score and https://docs.typesafe.ai/model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 . Score’s expected level thus weights the level numbers by probabilities obtained from level descriptions evaluated one at a time. We do not read Jev Score’s advantage as interpolation along an ordered scale. The exchange above places the difference in the two primitives’ probabilities for the same pairs, and it says nothing about how those probabilities arise.
blocks.zh: 供应商文件说,对每一级评分都单独评价,而且该模型没有看到某一等级的数目或其邻国。 它还将得分水平描述为数值校准薄弱。 3 3 3 https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/score和https://docs.typesafe.ai/model-jiggness/jev-1.13 。 。 。 因此,分数的预期水平按照从一次评价的级别描述中获得的概率来加权该级别数字。 我们不认为Jev Score的优势是按规定比例进行插值。 上面的交换将两个原始人对同一对的概率的区别放在了一起,它没有说这些概率是如何产生的.

blocks.en: Jev Choice and Jev Score give different levels on 215 of ELLIPSE’s 1,548 pairs and never differ by more than one level. Jev Score’s level is the higher one on 179 of the 215. On the 215 disagreements Jev Choice is exact on 8.4% and Jev Score on 21.9%. Because every judge places ELLIPSE essays below their labels (Section 5.3 ), the framing that answers one level higher gains exact accuracy on its disagreements.
blocks.zh: Jev Choice和Jev Score在ELLIPSE的1,548对中给出了不同的等级,并且从来没有超过一个等级的差异. Jev Score的级别是215人中179人中最高的。 在215个分歧中,Jev选择的精确率为8.4%,Jev得分的精确率为21.9%。 因为每位法官都会把ELLIPSE的散文置于他们的标签之下(第5.3节),所以回答一个级别更高的框架在它的分歧上获得了精确的准确性.

blocks.en: Score returns an expected level on levels numbered from 0, which Jev Score rounds half to even (Section 3.1 ), whereas the labels round halves up (Section 3.4 ). Of Jev Score’s 3,414 answers on the graded panels, 27 are exact halves, and the two rules give different levels on 12 of them. Ten lie halfway between the first and second level and two halfway between the third and fourth, where half to even rounds down. The other 15 halves lie between the second and third level, where both rules round up.
blocks.zh: 分数返回从0到平均分数的预期水平(第3.1节),而分数则减半(第3.4节)。 Jev Score在分级板上的3,414个答案中,有27个是精确的一半,两项规则对其中12个给出了不同的等级. 10个位于第一层和第二层之间,2个位于第三级和第四层之间,其中一半甚至下射。 其他15个半部分位于第二层和第三层之间,这两层规则都在此交汇.

blocks.en: The two graded framings obtain their Jev Noul verdicts on embedded binary pairs (Section 3.1 ) in separate requests. These verdicts differ on 4 of the 364 pairs and change a panel’s binary accuracy only on USR-PC (Table C3 f).
blocks.zh: 两个分级框架在分别的请求中获得了对嵌入式二进制配对(第3.1节)的Jev Noul判决。 这些判决对364对中的4对不同,仅在USR-PC上改变一个面板的二进制精度(表C3 f).

blocks.en: Jev Choice’s 28 abstentions (Table F1 ) fall into three groups. The largest, 17 FED-Dialogue error_recovery pairs, is discussed below. The eight HelpSteer2 correctness pairs are mostly responses with little checkable factual content: two answer a request for “a long list of wacky and wild superpowers”, one is the reply “You’re welcome! I’m glad I could help.”, three offer emotional support, and one is a role-play reply. The remaining response, a blog outline naming breweries in Rogers, Arkansas, does contain checkable facts. Six of the eight are labelled with the top level, “All pertinent facts are included and the response contains no errors.” HelpSteer2’s annotators had no abstain option. The last group holds three pairs. Two LFQA factuality answers, both written by Reddit users, make no factual claim (one is a one-line joke, the other advice to search before posting). A USR-PC engaging response, “why did you choose pink out of all colors ?”, can be assessed and was labelled “Interesting”, the top level.
blocks.zh: Jev Choice的28票弃权(表F1)分为三组。 下文将讨论最大的17个FED-Dial Logue错误_回收对。 八个帮助Steer2的正确性对大多是没有多少可核查的事实内容的响应:两个回答一个是要求"一长串疯狂和野生的超能力",一个是回答"欢迎你! 我很高兴我能帮忙, ArkansasRogers的一个博客, 8人中有6人被贴上顶级标签,“所有相关事实都包括在内,答复中没有任何错误。” HelpSteer2的注释员没有弃权的选择. 最后一组持有三对. 两个LFQA的事实性答案,都是Reddit用户写的,没有提出事实性的说法(一个是一行笑话,另一个建议在发布前搜索). USR-PC参与的反应是“为什么从各种颜色中选择粉红色?” ,可以加以评估,并标注“吸引”最高层。

blocks.en: FED offered its raters an N/A answer on every question. On error_recovery (“The system is able to recover from errors that it makes.”), 29 of the 125 sampled ratings (23.2%) are N/A answers, most of them with a note that the system made no error. The more N/A answers a dialogue received, the more probability Jev Choice put on the NA option (Figure F1 ; the Spearman correlation of Section 4.3 has p = 9 × 10 − 4 p=9\times 10^{-4} ). Jev Choice abstained on all 7 dialogues with two or more N/A answers, on 7 of the 8 with one, and on 3 of the 10 with none. Of the 17 dialogues it abstained on, 3 are labelled “Somewhat.” and 14 “Yes.” Its mean probability on the NA option is 0.57 on error_recovery , 0.11 on HelpSteer2 correctness , 0.023 on LFQA factuality , and below 0.02 on each of the other 32 graded criteria. These three criteria hold 27 of its 28 abstentions. Because abstentions leave the denominator (Section 3.5 ), Jev Choice’s FED-Dialogue exact accuracy rests on 208 ordinal pairs and Jev Score’s on 225.
blocks.zh: FED向它的评分员提供了对每个问题的答复。 关于错误的回收(“系统能够从其错误中恢复”),在125个抽样评级中,有29个(23.2%)是非/A答案,其中多数是注解系统没有出错。 得到的N/A对对话的回答越多,Jev Choice对NA选项的概率就越大(图F1;第4.3节的Spearman相关性有p=9×10−4 p=9\times 10×4}). Jev Choice对所有7个对话投了弃权票,回答两个或两个以上的N/A,8个中的7个有一个,10个中的3个没有。 在投弃权票的17次对话中,有3次被称作“某事 ” , 14次被称作“是 ” 。 它在NA选项上的平均概率为:错误-回收0.57,帮助Steer2正确性0.11,LFQA事实质量0.023,其他32级标准各低于0.02. 这三项标准占其28票弃权中的27票弃权。 由于弃权保留分母(第3.5节),Jev Choice的FED-Dial对话准确准确的准确性在于208正数对和Jev Score的225。

Filled markers are the 17 dialogues on which Jev Choice abstained and hollow markers the 8 it answered (Spearman ρ = 0.62 \rho=0.62 between the probability and the number of N/A answers).

blocks.en: Most of each LLM judge’s graded abstentions are on FED-Dialogue, nearly all of those on error_recovery , and most of them fall on pairs where Jev Choice also abstained (Table F1 gives the Jaccard indices). On HelpSteer2 four of Gemini’s five abstentions are pairs on which Jev Choice also abstained.
blocks.zh: 每名LLM法官的分级弃权者大多在FED-Dialogue上, Jev Choice也投弃权票。

blocks.en: Jev Choice answered the other 8 error_recovery dialogues, chose “No.” on each, and was wrong every time. Four of them carry the label “Somewhat.” and four the label “Yes.” The label on this criterion averages only the numeric ratings. Because most N/A answers report that no system error occurred, the numeric ratings likely come mainly from raters who saw an error to recover from. If so, the label rates recovery under a condition that the criterion text does not state.
blocks.zh: Jev Choice回答其他8个错误——恢复对话,选择“不”,每次都是错误的。 其中4个带有“什么”的标签,4个带有“是”的标签。 本标准上的标签仅平均值数字评级. 因为大多数N/A解答都报告说没有发生系统错误,所以数值评级可能主要来自看到错误后才能从中恢复的测评人. 如果是,标签在标准文本没有说明的条件下评定回收率。

blocks.en: The binary and graded panels offered different abstain options, and Jev Choice used only the second. On the binary panels the option was CANNOT_ASSESS, whose definition in Table A2 describes the evidence available to the judge and asks for rare use, and no judge chose it there (Appendix D ). The graded panels offered the NA option instead, whose wording can also describe the pair itself, a criterion that does not apply to the unit. Jev Choice’s abstentions fall mostly on pairs where that second reading fits. The two options also differ in the instruction to use the option rarely, in scale type, and in panel, so this contrast does not isolate the wording. Offering one wording on both kinds of panel would separate the wording from these differences, and no such run was made.
blocks.zh: 二进制和分级面板提供了不同的弃权选项,Jev Choice只使用了第二个. 在二进制面板上,选项是CANNOT_ASSSESS,表A2中的定义描述了法官可用的证据,并要求罕见使用,没有法官选择了该选项(附录D)。 分级的小组则提供了NA选项,其措辞也可以描述配对本身,这个标准不适用于单位. Jev Choice的弃权多数发生在二读时的对子上。 这两个选项在使用选项的指令上也存在差异,在比例类型和面板上很少使用,因此这种对比并不孤立措辞. 就这两种小组提出一种措词,将使措词与这些差别分开,没有进行这种讨论。

(b) Offset against the rounded label and against the unrounded mean of the two ratings. (c) L1: number of the 258 essays placed at level 1; L4–5: share (%) placed at levels 4–5. For the raters, one rating is regressed on the other with both orders pooled, which makes the slope equal to their QWK. DeepSeek scored 255 to 258 essays per trait.

blocks.en: The 11 criteria of Section 5.2 that lie far below the reference with mean offsets below − 0.5 -0.5 levels are the five ELLIPSE traits other than cohesion ; FED-Dialogue depth , error_recovery , informative , and inquisitive ; FED-Turn interesting ; and USR-PC engaging . The twelfth criterion far below the reference, FED-Turn engaging , has a mean offset of − 0.34 -0.34 levels.
blocks.zh: 第5.2节的11项标准远远低于参考值,平均抵消水平低于−0.5-0.5级,这些标准是除凝聚力以外的五个ELLIPSE特征;FED-对话深度、错误-恢复、信息性和询问性;FED-Turn有趣;USR-PC参与。 远远低于参考文献的第十二项标准FED-Turn Generation,平均抵消−0.34-0.34级。

blocks.en: Table G2: Five measures of the four matched judges’ mean gap over the 31 criteria of Figure 2 (post-hoc analysis). ρ \rho and p p : Spearman correlation of the gap with the mean offset. Min and mean gap in points, and the number of criteria more than 15 or 5 points below the reference. Unshifted: exact accuracy as in Figure 2 . Best shift and leave-one-out: the shifts of Section 5.3 , chosen on all of a criterion’s pairs or, for each pair, on the others. Both shifted: the rater reference also gets its own best shift. Spearman (below the rule): the judges’ mean Spearman correlation with the rater mean minus the rater reference’s, over the 30 criteria where it is defined, with min and mean as differences of correlations.
blocks.zh: 表G2:与图2的31项标准(事后分析)相比,4名法官的5项衡量标准相匹配。 ^\rho和p : Spearman 与平均偏差的关联性。 点数的中微差,标准数低于参考点15或5点。 未转换:准确准确如图2所示。 最佳换班和一档:第5.3节的换班,选择在一个标准的所有配对上,或者每个配对的换班。 两者都转变了:评分参考也得到了自己的最佳转变. Spearman(低于规则 ): 法官的平均Spearman与评分者的关系 , 等于 评分者参考 , 超过它定义的30 个标准, 以分钟和平均值作为相关性的差异 。

blocks.en: Table G2 compares the gap measure of Figure 2 with four that a constant shift cannot move. Neither ELLIPSE nor error_recovery produces the unshifted correlation, which stays at 0.887 without ELLIPSE (25 criteria) and at 0.918 without error_recovery . None of the four other measures correlates significantly with the mean offset. After the best shift, the 12 criteria far below the reference lie between 1.1 points below it and 13.8 points above, and the six ELLIPSE traits, whose raters need no shift (Section 5.3 ), range from 1.1 points below it ( vocabulary ) to 5.6 points above. On top-heavy three-level scales a rater’s best shift is often not zero. For FED-Turn fluent it raises the reference from 70.9% to 87.2%. The Both shifted row, which shifts judges and raters alike, is therefore the like-for-like comparison. The four criteria that then stay more than 5 points short of the reference are FED-Dialogue informative and diverse , LFQA factuality , and USR-PC engaging . They are the candidates for conventions that a shift of location does not capture, such as LFQA’s absolute top level (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 表G2将图2的空隙度量比为4,即恒移不能移动. 无论是ELLIPSE还是错误_恢复都无法产生非转移的关联性,该关联性在没有ELLIPSE(25个标准)的情况下停留在0.887,在0.918没有错误_恢复. 其他四项措施都没有与平均抵销额有重大关系。 在最佳转变之后,远远低于参考值的12项标准介于以下1.1点和以上13.8点之间,以及6个ELLIPSE特征,其评分值不需要变化(第5.3节),从下面1.1点(词汇)到以上5.6点不等. 在头重脚轻的三级尺度上,评分者的最佳转变往往不是零。 对于FED-Turn流利,参考率从70.9%提高到87.2%。 因此,两条转动的排位,既可以调换法官和评分,也是类似的比较。 与参考文献相比, 他们是改变地点无法捕捉到的公约的候选者,例如LFQA的绝对顶级(附录H).

blocks.en: Nearly every ELLIPSE error lies below the label. The share is 99.5% for Jev Choice. For the other judges it lies between 98.4% and 99.5%, except for DeepSeek at 96.9%. Because nearly all errors share one sign, Jev Choice’s mean absolute error (1.256 levels) and the magnitude of its mean signed error (1.247 levels) differ by less than 0.01 level.
blocks.zh: 几乎每个ELLIPSE错误都位于标签下方. Jev Choice的股份为99.5%。 其他法官为98.4%至99.5%,但DeepSeek为96.9%。 因为几乎所有错误都有一个符号,Jev Choice的平均绝对错误(1.256级)及其平均签名错误(1.247级)的大小相差小于0.01级.

blocks.en: Table G1 gives the results by trait. Jev Score, like the matched judges, is least accurate on grammar and most accurate on cohesion (Section 5.4 ). Measured from the two-rating mean before rounding, every offset is smaller in magnitude, by 0.19 to 0.27 levels, which is the amount by which the half-up rule raises each trait’s labels.
blocks.zh: 表G1按特征列出结果。 Jev Score与对应的法官一样,在语法方面最不准确,在凝聚力方面最准确(第5.4节)。 从四舍五入前的双级平均值计算,每个偏差在数量上都较小,为0.19至0.27级,这是半级规则提高每个特征标签的金额。

blocks.en: Table G3: ELLIPSE labels and the half-up rounding rule. Half-way labels are the 725 pairs whose two ratings average to a half level, which the rule rounds up, and other labels are the remaining 823 pairs (DeepSeek answered 1,543 pairs in all). The downward column is a post-hoc analysis that rounds the half-way means down instead. The last column is the offset in levels against the unrounded rater mean. The rule adds 0.23 levels to the pooled label.
blocks.zh: 表G3:ELLIPSE标签和半圆规则. 半程标签是725对,其两个收视率平均为半级,规则向上循环,其他标签是其余的823对(DeepSeek总共回答1,543对). 向下一栏是后热分析,绕过半程意味着向下. 最后一栏是按水平与未四舍五入的费率平均值抵消的数额。 该规则在集合标签中增加了0.23级.

blocks.en: Table G4: Post-hoc shift on USR engaging . Exact accuracy (%) with the recorded predictions ( s = 0 s=0 ) and with every prediction moved up one level, capped at the top level ( s = + 1 s=+1 ). Each judge scored 71 or 72 pairs on Topical-Chat and 59 or 60 on PersonaChat. The rater reference is computed on engaging alone, as in Figure 3 c, and is shown unshifted.
blocks.zh: 表G4:美国皇家空军的后轮任务 准确的准确性(%)与记录的预测(s = 0 s = 0),以及每次预测都向上移动一个级别,最高级别封顶(s = + 1 s=+1),每位裁判在Tripical-Chat上得分71或72对,在PersonaChat上得分59或60对. 如图3c所示,费率参考数是按单项雇用计算的,不转动。

blocks.en: Figure G1: Row-normalized ELLIPSE confusion matrices for Jev Choice, Gemini, and one rater against the other, with the diagonal outlined. Rows are the label level and columns the predicted level. For the raters, rows are one rating and columns the other rating of the same essay and trait, with both orders pooled. The level-1 rows hold fewer than 20 pairs and are omitted (hatched).
blocks.zh: 图G1:Jev Choice,双子座的列常态ELLIPSE混淆矩阵,以及一个评分器对另一个,并勾勒出对角. 行是标签级别,列是预测级别。 对评分者来说,行是一等,列是同一篇散文和特质的一等,两个订单都集合在一起. 一级行持量不足20对,并省略(夹).

blocks.en: Pooled over the six traits, individual ratings put 25.4% of ratings at levels 4–5, fewer than the labels’ 36.3%, and no judge places more than 9.3% of any trait’s predictions there (Table G1 c). At the bottom of the scale the pattern reverses. The rounded label is level 1 on one pair in 1,548, and the individual raters used level 1 on 11 of 3,096 ratings, whereas the judges predicted it on 30 (Gemini) to 376 (Luna) pairs, on grammar more than on any other trait.
blocks.zh: 个人收视率占到4-5级收视率的25.4%,比标签的36.3%少,没有任何法官给出超过9.3%的预测(表G1c)。 在尺度的底部,图案反向. 四舍五入的标签为1对1的1,548,个人评分在3,096分的11分中使用1级,而评分则预测在30对(Gemini)到376对(Luna),在语法上比任何其他特征都要多.

blocks.en: The judges compress the scale. Pooled over the 1,548 pairs, the regression slope of Table G1 d runs from 0.29 (Jev Score) to 0.44 (Gemini), with Jev Choice at 0.37. The same regression of one rater’s level on the other’s, over 3,096 ordered pairs of ratings, gives 0.50. This slope is below one because the two raters disagree. It is not a like-for-like benchmark for the judges, whose target, the two-rater label, is less noisy than a single rating. A judge with one rater’s noise would show a slope above 0.50 against the label, so a comparison with 0.50 understates the judges’ compression. Per trait, the judges’ slopes run from 0.14 to 0.54 and the raters’ from 0.44 to 0.54 (Table G1 d). Jev Choice’s within-one accuracy is 64.3%, and one rater is within one level of the other on 98.2% of ratings. For labels of level 3 to level 5, Jev Choice most often predicts level 2, and Gemini most often predicts one or two levels below the label (Figure G1 ).
blocks.zh: 评者压缩秤. 表G1d的回归坡率从0.29(Jev积分)到0.44(Gemini),其中Jev选择为0.37。 一个评级人对另一个评级的同样倒退,超过3,096对订购的评级,给0.50。 这个坡度低于一个,因为两个评级人不同意. 对法官来说,这不是一个相似的基准,他们的目标,即两个评分的标签,没有单一评分那么吵。 如果法官发出一个评分器的噪声,则会显示一个比标签高0.50的坡度,因此与0.50的比较会低估法官的压缩。 按特征计算,法官的坡度从0.14至0.54,评分者从0.44至0.54(表G1d)。 Jev Choice的内置精度为64.3%,在98.2%的评分中,一个评分在另一个等级之内。 对于第3级到第5级的标签,Jev Choice最常预测第2级,双子座最常预测标签下方的一两个级别(图G1).

blocks.en: Averaged over traits, Jev Choice’s Spearman correlation with the unrounded rater mean is 0.481, and one rater’s correlation with the other is 0.483. By this measure Jev Choice ranks essays about as well as a single rater. As with the slopes, the comparison favours the judge.
blocks.zh: 平均而言,Jev Choice的Spearman与未四舍五入率平均值的比值为0.481,而一个比值与另一个比值的比值为0.483。 通过这一措施,Jev Choice将有关论文和单一评分的分级。 和斜坡一样,比较有利于法官。

blocks.en: The ELLIPSE sample was stratified by bands of the holistic score (2.5 or below, 3 to 3.5, and 4 or above), which hold 432, 888, and 228 pairs. Every judge’s offset grows more negative from band to band, from − 1.02 -1.02 levels in the lowest band to − 1.63 -1.63 in the highest for Jev Choice and from − 0.59 -0.59 to − 1.09 -1.09 for Gemini. Compression predicts this pattern. When predictions rise by less than one level per label level, the offset grows with the label. The growth is consistent with the norm-referenced reading of Section 5.4 , but it does not by itself distinguish that reading from other causes of compression.
blocks.zh: ELLIPSE样本由整体分数(2.5或以下,3至3.5,4或以上)的波段进行分级,它们持有432,888和228对. 每个法官的抵消率从乐队到乐队的负数增加,从最低乐队的1.02-1.02级增加到Jev Choice最高的1.63-1.63级,双子座从0.59-0.59级增加到1.09-1.09级。 压缩可以预测这种模式. 当预测每个标签级别上升不到一个级别时,抵消随标签而增加。 增长与第5.4节的规范参考读法一致,但它本身并不将读法与其他压缩原因区分开来.

blocks.en: Figure 3 b plots a post-hoc analysis that moves every prediction by s s levels, clipped to the scale. Every judge’s exact accuracy peaks at s = + 1 s=+1 , at 46.8% (Luna) to 59.6% (Gemini) against the rater reference’s 51.4%, and falls to at most 33.5% at s = + 2 s=+2 and below 2% at s = − 1 s=-1 . Mean QWK also peaks at s = + 1 s=+1 , at 0.31 to 0.48, below the rater reference’s 0.50, and Jev Choice’s rises there from 0.15 to 0.34. Apart from clipping, a constant shift leaves the regression slopes above unchanged.
blocks.zh: 图3b 绘制了后热分析图,将每个预测按S级移动,剪切到比例尺。 每位法官的准确度峰值为S = + 1 s = = ,46.8% (Luna) 到59.6% (Gemini) 与 rater 参考值的51.4%相对应,最高为33.5% S = + 2 s = = 2(s = ) ,低于2% s = − 1 s = 1。 平均QWK在S = + 1 s=+1,在0.31到0.48的峰值下,比参考率的0.50低,Jev Choice的峰值从0.15上升到0.34. 除了剪接外,恒定的转移使回归坡度上方保持不变.

blocks.en: Table G3 isolates the rounding rule of Section 3.4 . Every judge is less accurate on the half-way labels than on the others, Jev Choice at 6.8% against 19.3%. Against the unrounded rater mean, four judges are 0.92 to 1.04 levels low and Gemini is 0.54 levels low.
blocks.zh: 表G3隔离了第3.4节的四舍五入规则. 每个法官在半程标签上的准确度低于其他人,Jev Choice为6.8%,对19.3%。 与未四舍五入的评分率平均值相比,四名法官为0.92至1.04级,双子座低0.54级。

blocks.en: Rounding the half-way means down instead, as a post-hoc analysis, changes the order of two judges. Jev Choice then overtakes Luna (29.1% against 28.6% exact), and Gemini’s lead over Jev Choice grows from 16.4 to 28.4 points. The downward rule lowers each half-way label by one level, which raises every offset by 0.47 levels (one level times the half-way share of 46.8%). That is less than the smallest offset magnitude, Gemini’s 0.77 levels, so every offset stays negative.
blocks.zh: 绕半程意味着向下,作为后热分析,改变两位裁判的顺序. Jev Choice随后超越了Luna(29.1%对28.6%),而双子座领先于Jev Choice的领先点从16.4点增加到28.4点。 下行规则将每个半程标签降低一个级别,将每个半程标签提高0.47个级别(一个级别是半程份额46.8%的两倍)。 这还不到最小的抵消规模,双子座的0.77级,因此每个抵消都保持负数。

blocks.en: Table G4 gives each judge’s exact accuracy on USR engaging before and after the post-hoc shift of Section 5.4 , Jev Score included. On PersonaChat every shifted judge exceeds the unshifted rater reference, a comparison that favours the judges for the reason given in Section 5.3 . The rater reference’s own best shift raises it there from 61.1% to 80.0%. Gemini’s shifted accuracy equals that value, and the other four judges fall 1.7 (Luna) to 10.5 points (Jev Choice) short of it. On Topical-Chat no shift raises the rater reference or any matched judge.
blocks.zh: 表G4给出了每位法官在第5.4节(包括Jev分数)后轮班前后进行USR的准确准确性。 关于PersonaChat,每个被调职的法官都超过了未调职的评分员参考,这种比较有利于法官,理由见第5.3节。 校对:Soup 双子座的精度变化等于这个数值,另外四名法官则跌到1.7(Luna),不及10.5分(Jev Choice). 在Topical-Chat上,没有班次提高评分参考或任何匹配的法官。

blocks.en: Table H3: Panel properties examined in Section 5.5 , with Jev Choice’s gap in the last two columns. Criterion length: range of criterion words and the Spearman correlation between a criterion’s length and Jev’s accuracy on it, over n n criteria (Jev Noul on RiceChem and HealthBench, and elsewhere Jev Choice on graded criteria only; the ELLIPSE value uses the criterion sentence alone). blocks.zh: 表H3:第5.5节所审查的小组财产,Jev Choice的缺额列于最后两栏。 标准长度:标准词的范围以及标准长度与Jev准确度之间的Spearman关联, 超过n标准(Jev Nul on RiceChem and Health Bench, 其他地方Jev只选择分级标准;ELLIPSE值仅使用标准句子). 一些健康本奇标准有一个文本(第3.3节),因此长度相同。 单位字:单位每单位中位白空字. Quartiles: Jev Choice 的精确度(%)按单位长度的四分位数计算,包括嵌入式二进制配对。 Raters:人类标签的来源(TA,教学辅助注释;经过培训的散文评分;人群工作者;对话研究者;HelpSteer2上发布的标签). 间隙 : Jev Choice的数值减去评分参考值,以准确准确(第3.5节)和平均QWK表示。 破折号标记一个未计算或不存在的值。

blocks.en: The ELLIPSE example of Table H2 is one of Jev Choice’s confident errors (Appendix J ). Both raters put the essay at level 2 on grammar , and all five judges put it at level 1. Gemini’s explanation reports errors in nearly every clause, which it matches to the level 1 description “Errors in grammar and usage throughout.” The level descriptions give no base rate, so they do not say how many errors separate “throughout” from “many” in essays by grade 8–12 English learners. Rater training on that population would supply such a base rate (Section 5.4 ). The judges lack it and placed this essay one level lower, as the population-norm account predicts.
blocks.zh: 表H2的ELLIPSE实例是Jev Choice自信错误(Appendix J)之一. 两名评委都把论文放在第2级的语法, 1. 双子座的解释报告几乎每个条款都有错误,这与第1级描述 " 语法和整个使用中的错误 " 相符。 级别说明没有给出基准率,因此没有说有多少错误将论文中按8至12年级的英语学习者 " 通通 " 与 " 许多 " 分开。 关于该人群的评级培训将提供这种基准率(第5.4节)。 法官们缺乏这种能力,将这篇论文放在较低的一级,正如人口与规范的叙述所预测的那样。

blocks.en: Table H2 also quotes the two LFQA answers of Section 5.4 , on which all five judges chose “Partially accurate”. The false claims that the LLM judges name are that LED TVs create images with light-emitting diodes and that an SD card needs no power supply. In both cases the label departs from the text of the top level, and the judges reject the top level for the reason its text gives. HelpSteer2 shows a related pattern at a level that is neither the top nor absolute. None of the five judges chose complexity level 4 or 5 in 450 predictions, although the labels put 10 of the 90 responses at level 4.
blocks.zh: 表H2还引用了第5.4节中两个LFQA的答复,所有五名法官都选择“部分准确”。 假称LLM评委名称是LED电视机制造带有放光二极管的图像,SD卡不需要供电. 在这两种情况下,标签都偏离了最高层的文本,法官们拒绝最高层,理由是其文本给出的原因。 帮助 转向架2在既不是顶级,也不是绝对级显示相关模式. 虽然标签将90个回复中的10个放在4级,但这5名法官都没有在450个预测中选择4级或5级的复杂性。

blocks.en: Three of the twelve sampled USR-TC contexts carry the literal string _nofact in place of a fact, and the 18 uses_knowledge pairs from these contexts are the ones counted in Table 3 . The LLM judges’ explanations show that they read the string as the absence of a fact (Table H2 ). The understandable criterion text excludes well-formedness from the judgment. The raters nonetheless marked self-contradictory responses such as the one quoted UNMET, and every judge is correct on at most 34.8% of the 23 pairs labelled UNMET.
blocks.zh: 在12个抽样的USR-TC语境中,有3个带有文字字符串_nofact来代替一个事实,这些语境中的18个使用_知识对是表3中计算出来的。 LLM法官的解释表明,他们将弦视为不存在事实(表H2)。 可以理解的标准案文从判决中排除了造型良好。 然而,检测器标记了自相矛盾的反应,例如引用的UMET,在标注为UNMET的23对中,每个判断器最多34.8%是正确的。

blocks.en: Jev Choice makes 117 errors on USR-TC, counting its Jev Noul verdicts on the two binary criteria. Of these, 16 are the _nofact pairs of uses_knowledge and 17 are understandable pairs labelled UNMET. Another 63 are ordinal errors on split pairs. The remaining 21 errors (17.9%) are 19 ordinal errors on unanimous pairs and two other binary errors. They are the only errors that fall neither on a split pair nor under a candidate convention, and those conventions were themselves identified from the judges’ errors (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: Jev Choice在USR-TC上犯了117个错误,将其Jev Noul判决计入两个二进制标准. 其中16对是“nofact couples”的用途,17对是标注为“UNMET”的易懂的对。 另外63个是拆分对上的正统错误. 其余21个错误(17.9%)是19个对齐的正统错误和另外两个二进制错误. 它们是既非两码事也非候选公约规定的唯一错误,这些公约本身是从法官的错误中找出的(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: On two panels a no-read baseline (Section 3.4 ) is competitive on exact accuracy. The HelpSteer2 correctness text asks for a fact check, but its label tracks overall helpfulness (Pearson r = 0.94 r=0.94 over the 90 responses; Table 3 ). HelpSteer2’s constant predictor has a QWK of zero by construction. The judges that trail it significantly (Section 4.1 ) do so with p ≤ 2.1 × 10 − 4 p\leq 2.1\times 10^{-4} in pair-level sign tests. The LFQA provenance baseline is most accurate on amount_info (74.2%) and formality (73.3%) and least on factuality (56.7%). Without provenance, the modal level of each criterion scores 61.1% over the panel, against the provenance baseline’s 68.1%. In the pair-level sign tests of Section 4.1 , every judge’s p p against the provenance baseline is at least 0.27.
blocks.zh: 在两个面板上,不读基线(第3.4节)在准确性上具有竞争力。 HelpSteer2的正确性文本要求进行事实检查,但其标签跟踪总的有用性(Pearson r = 0.94 r = 0.94,超过90个答复;表3 ). HelpSteer2的常数预测器通过构造的QWK为0. 跟踪它的法官(第4.1节)在对等的标志测试中使用2.1×10−4 p\leq 2.1\times 10×4}进行。 LFQA的出处基准在量_info(74.2%)和形式性(73.3%)方面最准确,在事实性(56.7%)方面最不准确。 没有来源,每个标准的模式水平比面板高61.1%,而来源基线为68.1%。 在4.1节的对等标志测试中,每位法官的p比原产地基线至少0.27。

blocks.en: Table H3 gives the four panel properties of Section 5.5 next to Jev Choice’s gap to the reference in exact accuracy and in mean QWK. The two measures put Jev Choice on the same side of the reference on four panels, above it on LFQA and USR-TC and below it on ELLIPSE and USR-PC. On the two FED panels Jev Choice is below the reference in exact accuracy and above it in mean QWK, and part of this pattern may come from the reference’s smaller target (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 表H3将第5.5节的四个面板属性放在Jev Choice的空白旁边,以准确准确和平均QWK表示。 这两项措施使Jev Choice在四个面板的参考文献中处于同一面,上面是LFQA和USR-TC,下面是ELLIPSE和USR-PC。 在两个FED小组中,Jev Choice准确性低于参考标准,在平均QWK中高于参考标准,这一模式的一部分可能来自参考标准较小的目标(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: Within panels, criterion length shows no consistent relation with Jev’s per-criterion accuracy, and with few criteria per panel the test is weak. The correlations of Table H3 are not significant on the binary panels ( p = 0.18 p=0.18 on RiceChem, 0.12 0.12 on HealthBench) or on the FED panels ( p = 0.83 p=0.83 on FED-Turn, 0.43 0.43 on FED-Dialogue). ELLIPSE is ambiguous. Its six criterion sentences share one template and differ in length by at most nine words, yet their length orders Jev Choice’s per-trait accuracy perfectly (Spearman 1.00). Level-description length, which ranges from 44 to 133 words, correlates at 0.60 ( p = 0.21 p=0.21 ). With six traits, length cannot be separated from what each trait’s levels describe (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 在面板内,标准长度显示与Jev的每条标准准确性没有一致的关系,而且每个面板的标准很少,因此测试很弱。 表H3的关联性在二进制面板(水稻Chem的p=0.18 p=0.18,Health Bench的0.12 0.12)或FED面板(FED-Turn的p=0.83,FED-对话的0.43 0.43)上均不显著. ELLIPSE是含糊不清的。 它的6个标准句子共用一个模板,长度不同,最多9个字,但其长度却决定了Jev Choice的每轨精度完美(Spearman 1.00). 级别描述长度从44到133个字不等,关联时间为0.60(p=0.21 p=0.21). 有六个特征,长度不能与每个特征水平所描述的(表3)分开。

blocks.en: Unit length has no common effect. By quartile of unit length, Jev Choice’s accuracy on ELLIPSE falls from 16.4% in the shortest quartile to 11.2–12.3% in the two longest, and on FED-Dialogue it is lowest in the shortest quartile (37.5%). Elsewhere it moves by up to 18.9 points without a consistent direction. The ELLIPSE offset also grows with the holistic band (Appendix G ), and this slice does not separate essay length from essay quality. Across panels, the three with the shortest units, FED-Turn, USR-PC, and USR-TC, have gaps that run from 16.2 points below the reference to 0.3 points above it.
blocks.zh: 单位长度没有共同效果. Jev Choice在ELLIPSE上的精度从最短的四分位数的16.4%下降到最长的两分位数的11.2–12.3 %,在FED-Dial conversation中则从最短的四分位数(37.5%)降到最低。 在其他地方,它移动最多18.9个点,没有一致的方向。 ELLIPSE的抵消也随着整体波段(Appendix G )的增长而增长,这个片段并没有将散文长度与散文质量区分开来. 横跨面板,三个最短的单元,即FED-Turn、USR-PC和USR-TC,其间距从上面的0.3点的16.2点以下。

blocks.en: Rater expertise does not order the gaps either. ELLIPSE, the only graded panel with trained raters, has Jev Choice’s largest gap (Section 5.5 ), but among the crowd-rated panels the gap runs from + 13.3 +13.3 points on LFQA to − 16.3 -16.3 on FED-Dialogue (Table H3 ).
blocks.zh: Rater专业技术也不要求存在空白。 ELLIPSE是唯一一个有受过训练的评分小组,拥有Jev Choice的最大差距(第5.5节),但在人群评分小组中,差距从LFQA的+13.3+13.3分到FED-对话的−16.3-16.3分(表H3)。

blocks.en: Scale width changes the chance level of exact accuracy (Section 3.5 ), but panels with the same scale can still differ widely. USR-TC and USR-PC share their three-level scales and their criterion texts (Section 5.4 ), and Jev Choice’s gap is + 0.3 +0.3 points on the first and − 16.2 -16.2 points on the second.
blocks.zh: 缩放宽度会改变准确准确度的概率水平(第3.5节),但同样比例的面板仍会有很大差异. USR-TC和USR-PC分享它们的三级比分和标准文本(第5.4节),Jev Choice的差值为第一比0.3+0.3分,第二比16.2-16.2分。

blocks.zh: 附录一 信心

blocks.en: The vendor describes the confidence field that Choice and Score return as a number computed from how the probabilities are spread, and its interactive demo approximates it for three options by ( 3 ​ p max − 1 ) / 2 (3p_{\max}-1)/2 . 4 4 4 https://docs.typesafe.ai/confidence . For Jev Choice the field matches the general form ( K ​ p max − 1 ) / ( K − 1 ) (Kp_{\max}-1)/(K-1) , where p max p_{\max} is the largest returned probability and K K counts every option, the NA option included. The largest deviation from this formula is 0.0225 over the 3,414 graded Jev Choice answers, with a mean of 0.006, and 0.015 over the 8,392 binary answers on the full RiceChem set, where K = 3 K=3 . These deviations are larger than two-decimal rounding of the returned values would produce, so the formula approximates the field closely without describing it exactly. The formula does not describe Jev Score’s confidence (median deviation 0.10, maximum 0.46), which is used as returned. Noul returns no confidence field, and the Noul confidence of Section 3.1 is the same normalization with K = 2 K=2 . The embedded binary pairs of the graded panels enter every Jev Choice analysis with this Noul confidence.
blocks.zh: 销售商描述了选择和得分返回作为从概率如何分布计算出来的数字的信心领域,其交互式演示为三种选择提供了近似值(3 p max− 1) / 2 (3p_{\max}-1)/2。 4 4 https://docs.typesafe.ai/ confession。 Jev选择的字段与一般形式(K p max− 1)/(Kp_{\max}-1)/(K-1)相匹配,其中p max p_{\max}是最大返回概率,K计算每个选择,包括NA选项。 该公式的最大偏差是3,414分级的Jev Choice答案的0.0225,平均值为0.006,完全的RiceChem集上的8,392二进制答案的0.015,其中K=3K=3. 这些偏差大于返回值的二进制四舍五入将产生,因此公式在不准确描述的情况下,对字段进行了紧密的近似. 该公式未描述Jev Score的置信度(中间偏差0.10,最大0.46),该置信度被用作返回. 努尔返回无信任场,第3.1节的努尔信任与K=2K=2的正常化相同. 分级面板的嵌入式二进制对使用这个Noul置信性输入每个Jev选择分析.

blocks.en: Table I1: Jev’s confidence on the graded panels. (a) Jev Choice’s error rate by confidence band, with the number of pairs in parentheses, and the AUROC of confidence for Jev Choice’s correctness; USR-PC is also split by criterion. (b) Jev Score’s error rate by Jev Score’s own confidence. (c) Repeated errors as a share of the LLM verdicts on Jev Choice’s wrong pairs, then the independence baseline, both as defined in Section 6.2 , with the number of Jev Choice errors in parentheses. The baseline is undefined for three verdicts each on ELLIPSE and HelpSteer2, whose combination of criterion and label occurs on no other pair. (d) Jev Choice’s accuracy on its most confident pairs, with ties broken by unit and criterion. (e) AUROC for each criterion with at least 25 answered pairs and at least one pair of each outcome; ∗ marks criteria with fewer than five pairs in the smaller outcome, whose AUROC rests on too few pairs to interpret. Embedded binary pairs are included in (a) to (e).
blocks.zh: 表I1:Jev对分级板的信心。 (a) Jev Choice的误差率按置信带计算,括号内为对数,AUROC对Jev Choice正确性的信心;USR-PC也按标准划分。 (b) 以Jev Score本身的信心计算Jev Score的误差率。 (c) 重复错误作为Jev Choice错误的LLM判决的一部分,然后是第6.2节所界定的独立基线,括号内为Jev Choice错误的数目。 在ELLIPSE和HelpSteer2上各有3个判决,其标准与标签的组合发生在没有其他对上,基线没有定义. (d) Jev Choice最自信的对子的准确性,按单位和标准划分关系。 (e) 每种标准的AUROC至少有25对答案,每个结果至少有一对;* 标记标准在较小的结果中少于5对,其AUROC依靠太少的对解释。 嵌入式二进制配对包含在(a)至(e)中.

blocks.en: Outside ELLIPSE, Jev Choice’s error rate falls between the 0.25–0.5 band and the top band on every panel, by 13.3 to 39.6 points (Table I1 a), and the three largest falls are on FED-Turn, LFQA, and USR-TC. On ELLIPSE, where the error rate is flat across bands (Section 6.1 ), confidence is also unrelated to the size of the error (Spearman − 0.03 -0.03 between confidence and absolute level error, p = 0.23 p=0.23 , over 1,548 pairs). The lowest band is small on every panel and holds a single pair on ELLIPSE and on LFQA.
blocks.zh: 在ELLIPSE之外,Jev Choice的误差率在0.25–0.5波段和每面板上最高的波段之间下降13.3–39.6分(表I1 a),三个最大的跌幅在FED–Turn,LFQA,和USR-TC上. 在ELLIPSE上,在跨波段(第6.1节)误差率平坦的地方,置信度也与误差大小无关(Spearman – 0.03 - 0.03在置信度与绝对值误差之间,p=0.23 p=0.23,超过1,548对). 最低的乐队在每个面板上都很小,在ELLIPSE和LFQA上都持有单对.

blocks.en: Read post hoc, the criterion-level AUROCs of Table I1 e show where confidence fails inside a panel. The AUROC is below 0.45 on five criteria with at least five pairs in each outcome: ELLIPSE phraseology and conventions , FED-Turn interesting , FED-Dialogue informative , and LFQA factuality . All five carry a negative offset for Jev Choice, from − 0.58 -0.58 levels on factuality to − 1.38 -1.38 on phraseology . LFQA factuality also concentrates its panel’s errors. Jev Choice is wrong on 59.3% of its 118 pairs, against 18.3% and 16.7% on the panel’s other two criteria. The USR-PC engaging error rate is flat over the three occupied bands, which hold its 59 pairs, and without engaging USR-PC’s error rate falls steeply with confidence (Table I1 a).
blocks.zh: 读取 post 特设, 表 I1 e 的标准级 AUROCs 显示一个面板内部的置信失败之处 。 AUROC在5项标准上低于0.45, 每项结果至少有5对:ELLIPSE语法和公约、FED-Turn 有趣、FED-对话信息、FLFQA事实质量。 所有这五个国家都承担着Jev Choice的负抵消,从关于事实的− 0.58-0.58级到关于用语的− 1.38-1.38级。 LFQA的事实性也集中了它的面板的错误. Jev选择在它的118对中59.3%是错的,而在小组的另外两项标准上是18.3%和16.7%。 USR-PC的操作误差率在三个占用带上是平的,这三个带保持59对,如果不接触USR-PC的操作误差率就会随着信心而急剧下降(表I1a)。

blocks.en: Jev Score’s error rate is lower in the top band than in the lowest on six panels and rises between the two upper bands on ELLIPSE (Table I1 b). On FED-Turn’s ordinal pairs, Jev Score’s most confident quarter is 86.3% exact against 66.7% overall, and Jev Choice’s 71.0% against 56.2%. These values exclude the embedded binary pairs, which Table I1 d includes.
blocks.zh: Jev Score的错误率在最高波段比在六个面板上的最低波段要低,并在ELLIPSE上的两个上波段之间上升(表I1 b). 在FED-Turn的正统配对上,Jev Score最自信的四分之一是86.3%,总体为66.7%,Jev Choice的71.0%是56.2%。 这些值不包括嵌入式二进制配对,表I1d包含这些配对.

blocks.en: Table I1 d restricts Jev Choice to the 25%, 50%, and 75% of pairs on which it is most confident. At 25% coverage accuracy is 9.8 to 20.2 points above the full-coverage value on five panels, 3.2 points above on FED-Dialogue, and 1.0 point above on ELLIPSE. These accuracies include the embedded binary pairs, so on the FED and USR panels the full-coverage column differs from Table 2 .

blocks.en: The pool is every pair Jev Choice answered wrongly, abstentions excluded, with confidence as in Appendix I . Pairs are sorted by confidence, highest first, with ties broken by unit identifier and then by criterion name. The sample holds 84 errors, 83 on ordinal pairs and one on an embedded binary pair, a _nofact pair of USR-TC uses_knowledge . On four panels (ELLIPSE, FED-Turn, HelpSteer2, and USR-TC) one further error shares the twelfth-highest confidence value and falls outside the sample. blocks.en: Luna repeats 81 of the 84 errors, Gemini 80, and DeepSeek 81 (Table J1 gives the panels). Under the independence baseline the three would repeat 126.7 of their 252 verdicts. The expected count per panel is highest on FED-Dialogue, 27.6 of 36, and lowest on USR-TC, 11.8. Jev Score gives Jev Choice’s answer on all 84, but it is the same model asked a different question, so it is not counted as corroboration.
blocks.zh: 露娜重复84个错误中的81个,双子座80,和DeepSeek 81(表J1给出了面板). 根据独立基准,这三人将重复其252项判决中的126.7项。 每个面板的预期计数最高的是FED-对话,36人中的27.6人,最低的是USR-TC,11.8人. Jev Score为Jev Choice提供了全部84的答案,但同一型号却提出了不同的问题,因此不算为确证.

blocks.en: In all 12 ELLIPSE errors Jev Choice put the essay at level 1 (eight on grammar , three on syntax , and one on conventions ), and all five judges give that level on 10 of them. Nine of these labels are level 2 and three are level 3. The two raters agreed on six, each time at level 2, and the other six labels are half-way means that the half-up rule rounded up, from ratings of 1 and 2 on three errors and of 2 and 3 on the other three. Every FED-Dialogue error is a “No.” prediction shared by all five judges, eight of them on depth , and 11 of the 12 FED-Turn errors are “No.” predictions too. The five judges also agree on each of the 12 LFQA errors, ten on formality and two on amount_info . On USR-PC the errors are 12 engaging pairs on which Jev Choice chose “Dull” against a label of “Somewhat interesting” (nine) or “Interesting” (three). One of them has unanimous raters, and so do three USR-TC errors, the _nofact pair among them. Five HelpSteer2 coherence errors lie one level above the label, where all five judges chose the top level, “Fully clear and internally consistent throughout.”
blocks.zh: 在全部12个ELLIPSE错误中,Jev Choice将散文放在第一级(8个关于语法,3个关于语法,1个关于公约),所有5名法官对其中10个给予该等级. 其中9个标签是二级,3个是三级 3个 两位评分同意6,每2级评分,其他6个标分为半程,意味着半程评分规则从1分和2分对3个差错,2分和3分对另外3个差错的评分开始四舍五入. 每个FED-对话错误都是一个“不”的预测,所有5名法官中有8名是深度的,12个FED-Turn错误中有11个是“不”的预测。 5名法官还同意了12个LFQA错误中的每一个,10个在形式上,2个在量_info上. 在USR-PC上,错误是Jev Choice在“Dull”标签上选择了“Dull”(9个)或“Interesting”(3个)。 其中有一个有一致的评分, 三个USR-TC 错误,其中的_nofact对。 五个HelpSteer2一致性错误位于标签之上的一级,这五个法官都选择了最高一级,“整个过程非常清晰,内部一致。 “

blocks.en: Table J2 also gives, over every ordinal pair the four matched judges all scored, the share on which all four are wrong. Apart from ELLIPSE (Section 5.1 ), it is 17.2% to 31.5%.
blocks.zh: 表J2还给出了每对正数对四个配对的评委全部得分,这四个评委都错了。 除了ELLIPSE(第5.1节)之外,该比率为17.2%至31.5%。

blocks.en: The sample covers only the most confident errors. For all of Jev Choice’s errors, Table I1 c gives the shares of repeated errors by band, which Figure 4 b plots, next to their independence baseline. The baseline rises with confidence on several panels, from 49.1% in the 0.25–0.5 band to 63.7% in the top band on ELLIPSE and from 24.8% to 54.6% on USR-PC. Part of the rise in Figure 4 b therefore follows from each LLM judge’s own tendencies given the criterion and the label. Two variants leave the rise with confidence intact. Restricting the count to ordinal pairs changes the top band only on USR-TC, to 83.3%, but lowers USR-TC’s 0.5–0.75 band from 66.4% to 58.3%, because the LLM judges also give Jev’s answer on its embedded binary errors there. It moves no other band of Figure 4 b by more than 4.0 points. Counting LLM abstentions and call failures as non-repeats lowers no band by more than 1.9 points.
blocks.zh: 样本只涵盖最自信的错误. 对于Jev Choice的所有错误,表I1c给出了重复错误的波段份额,图4b图,旁边是它们的独立性基线。 基线在几个面板上充满信心地上升,在ELLIPSE上从0.25-0.5波段的49.1%升至63.7%,在USR-PC上从24.8%升至54.6%。 因此,图4b的增加部分来自每个LLM法官自己的倾向,因为标准和标签。 两种变体让上升充满信心而完好无损. 将计数限制在正数对上,只改变USR-TC上的最高波段为83.3%,但将USR-TC的0.5–0.75波段从66.4%降低到58.3%,因为LLM评委也给出了Jev嵌入式二进制错误的答案. 它不会使图4b的其他波段移动超过4.0点. 计算 LLM 弃权和调用失败作为非重复使无波段降低1.9分以上.

blocks.en: HealthBench’s confident errors were selected by a different rule and are reported separately. They are Jev Noul’s six false positives with the highest probability of yes, from 0.91 to 0.96, and the six false negatives with the lowest, from 0.08 to 0.12. Of the 32 LLM verdicts that repeat Jev’s answer on them (Section 6.2 ), Luna gives 11, Gemini 10, and DeepSeek 11. Over all 92 of Jev Noul’s HealthBench errors the three LLM judges repeat 55.8% of their verdicts, against a baseline of 27.5%. For Jev Choice’s errors the shares are 58.4% and 27.1%.
blocks.zh: 健康奔驰的自信错误是由不同的规则选择的,并单独报告. 它们是Jev Noul的6个假阳性,最有可能是 " 是 " ,从0.91到0.96,以及最低的6个假阴性,从0.08到0.12。 在重复Jev对其所作答复的32项LLM判决(第6.2节)中,Luna给出了11项、双子座10项和DeepSeek 11项。 Jev Noul的《健康奔驰》中共有92个错误, 三位LLM法官重复了55.8%的判决, Jev Choice的错误是58.4%和27.1%。

blocks.en: A median of four levels is not unique when the four judges split evenly, which happens on 7.4% to 22.9% of a panel’s pairs. We therefore score the four-judge jury with both the lower and the upper median, so that the tie rule favours no judge (Table J2 ). The upper median is the most accurate of the three juries on every panel except USR-TC. Its best result, on USR-PC, is 1.0 point above the most accurate matched judge, with an interval of − 2.3 -2.3 to + 4.3 +4.3 points. Restricted to ordinal pairs, the three-judge median is above that judge only on USR-TC, by 1.4 points (interval − 2.8 -2.8 to + 5.1 +5.1 ). Of the two confident errors on which the three-judge median does not give Jev’s answer (Section 6.4 ), it gives the label on a USR-TC pair and a third level on an ELLIPSE pair. The four-judge lower median is right on none of the 84 confident errors and the upper median on one.
blocks.zh: 当四位法官平分时,四级的中位数并不是独一无二的,这发生在7.4%到22.9%的评委中。 因此,我们以中位数和中位数对四位法官的陪审团进行评分,这样,比分规则就不利于法官(表J2)。 除USR-TC外,每个评审小组的三个陪审团中,上中位数是最准确的. 它在USR-PC上的最佳结果是比最精确匹配的裁判员高1.0分,间隔为−2.3-2.3至+4.3+4.3分. 限制在正弦对数上,只有USR-TC时,三位法官的中位数高于该法官,为1.4分(间隔-2.8-2.8至+5.1+5.1)。 在三位法官的中位数没有给出Jev答案的两个自信错误中(第6.4节),它给USR-TC对和ELLIPSE对第三级的标签。 在84个自信错误中,4名法官的下中位数都是正确的,在一个上中位数是正确的。

blocks.en: Each of the 50 halvings of Table 4 splits a panel’s units into two halves with a seeded permutation. Each half in turn makes four choices on its own pairs: a threshold for each fallback; the best cascade’s fallback and threshold, under the rule above; the best single judge among the same candidates; and the smallest threshold at which a cascade with that half’s best LLM judge as fallback matches that judge. The other half is scored with these choices, and a halving pools its two scored halves. Recomputing the oracle-threshold choices with the same code reproduces Tables 4 and K1 . Cross-fitted gains over the fallback alone stay large only over weak fallbacks, 12.2 points over Luna on HelpSteer2 and 8.3 over Luna on HealthBench. With each panel’s best LLM judge as fallback they run from − 2.1 -2.1 to + 1.3 +1.3 points. Jev Score is the best single judge in 99 of the 100 FED-Turn halves. On the six panels whose oracle cost in Table 4 is 10% to 59%, the cross-fitted cascade matches the best LLM judge on the held-out half in only 46% to 64% of halves.
blocks.zh: 表4的50分之一将一个面板的单位分为两个半部分,并有播种花纹。 每半个都根据自己的对子做出四个选择:每个倒计时的门槛;根据上述规则,最好的级联倒计时和门槛;同一候选人中的最佳单一法官;以及最小的门槛,一个与该半个最优秀的LLM法官相匹配的级联。 另一半是用这些选择得分的,一半的游泳池则得分减半。 用相同的代码重制甲骨文-门槛选择,复制表4和K1. 单靠倒背而得的交叉收益仅比弱的倒背而得大,Luna在HelpSteer2上得12.2分,Luna在Health Bench上得8.3分. 由于每个小组最优秀的LLM评委是倒计时,他们从−2.1-2.1到+1.3+1.3分不等。 Jev Score是100个FED-Turn seconds中99个最佳单曲评委. 在表4的甲骨文成本为10%至59%的6个板块上,跨型级联匹配了被搁置的一半中最优秀的LLM裁判,只有46%至64%。

blocks.zh: 表 K2 应用表4倒数和\ tau 的身份。 倒置导致Jev在每一个面板的推迟对上. 在Jev保存超过两对的5个分级板的保存对子上,Jev以0.7至1.9分领先后退,无铅显著(p 0.45 p\geq 0.45 ). 稻米 Chem是Jev显著领先于其保存的对(63至26,p=1×10−4,p=1\times 10×4})的一个面板. 最好的米Chem级联服从于双子座,Jev Noul的得分超过双子座,因此它比双子座获得4.5分,仍然仅次于Jev Choice. Health Bench比双子座的2.0点增益依赖于18到10的保有-pair铅(p=0.18 p=0.18 ).

blocks.en: The last row of Table K2 illustrates the identity. It repeats HelpSteer2 with Gemini at τ = 0.30 \tau=0.30 , the oracle threshold on this panel with Luna or DeepSeek as fallback. Gemini wins the deferred pairs 16 to 1 ( p = 3 × 10 − 4 p=3\times 10^{-4} ), but that advantage cancels. On the kept pairs Jev is behind Gemini (54.5% against 56.1%), so the cascade (52.8%) ends below Gemini alone (54.3%).
blocks.zh: 表K2的最后一行说明了身份. 它重复了双子座的HelpSteer2 =\ 0.30\ tau=0.30,这个面板上的甲骨文阈值以月球或DeepSeek作为倒置. 双子座以16比1(p = 3 × 10 − 4 p = 3\times 10^{-4})获胜,但这一优势被取消. 在保留配对上,Jev位于双子座后方(54.5%对56.1%),因此级联(52.8%)仅位于双子座下方(54.3%).

blocks.en: The last column of Table K1 fixes τ = 0.75 \tau=0.75 on every graded panel. For the fallback of Table 4 this is already the oracle threshold on FED-Turn, LFQA, and USR-TC, and it matches the oracle accuracy on HelpSteer2 and USR-PC, whose oracle threshold is 0.50. The fixed threshold falls below Gemini alone on ELLIPSE and FED-Dialogue. Near their maxima the curves are flat (Figure K1 ). With Gemini as fallback, accuracy stays within 1.4 points of the oracle threshold’s for every τ \tau from 0.55 up on FED-Turn, from 0.30 up on USR-PC, and from 0.40 up on HelpSteer2.
blocks.zh: 表K1的最后一栏更正=0.75\tau=0.75,每一分级面板。 对于表4的倒置,这已经是FED-Turn,LFQA,和USR-TC上的甲骨文阈值,它与HelpSteer2和USR-PC上的甲骨文精度一致,其甲骨文阈值为0.50. 固定阈值在ELLIPSE和FED-Dialogue上仅低于双子座. 在它们的最大值附近,曲线是平的(图K1)。 由于双子座是倒置的,精确度从FED-Turn的0.55到USR-PC的0.30到0.40到HelpSteer2的0.40到HelpSteer2的0.4点,一直保持在甲骨文阈值的1.4点以内。

blocks.en: With the best LLM judge of each panel as fallback and oracle thresholds, the reach of Table K1 stays below 60% on HealthBench and on the five graded panels other than ELLIPSE and FED-Dialogue, which need nearly every pair deferred. Table 4 states the same matches as shares of that judge’s cost, which add Jev’s own cost to the deferred share. Where Jev alone is at least as accurate as a fallback, as for all three RiceChem fallbacks, the reach is zero. On FED-Turn, Jev Score alone reaches 70.7% on the cascade pair set, above every cascade, at about 1/650 of Gemini’s cost.
blocks.zh: 由于每个面板中最好的LLM判断器是倒数和甲骨文阈值,表K1在Health Bench和除了ELLIPSE和FED-Dialogue以外的5个分级面板上的影响仍然保持在60%以下,它们几乎需要每对推迟. 表4显示与法官费用份额相同,将Jev自己的费用加在递延份额。 在Jev独自至少与倒背一样准确的地方,与所有三个RiceChem倒背一样,其影响为0. 在FED-Turn上,Jev Score以双子座成本的1/650左右在每套级联上达到70.7%。

blocks.en: LFQA’s cascade does not reduce to sending one criterion to the fallback. Routing every factuality pair to Luna and keeping Jev Choice’s verdicts elsewhere gives 69.8%, below both the confidence cascade (72.1%) and Luna alone (71.5%). Routing any one or two of the three criteria to Luna gives at most 70.9%, reached with factuality and amount_info together.
blocks.zh: LFQA的级联不会减少向倒计时发送一个标准. 让Jev Choice的判决维持在其他地方, 将三个标准中的任意一个或两个告诉Luna最多给出70.9%,达到事实质量和金额_info一起.

blocks.en: The linear cost estimate of Table K1 assumes that a deferred pair costs the fallback’s average per pair. Deferred pairs may be longer or shorter than average and need more or fewer reasoning tokens.

blocks.en: Table L1: Each expectation from the binary panels and its status on the seven graded panels. holds : the graded panels agree. holds in narrower form : they agree within the scope given in the evidence. reversed : they show the opposite direction. fails : they contradict it. undetermined : the graded panels as run do not decide it. not examined : the graded panels as run could not test it. Cascade results are post-hoc analysis.

blocks.en: The expectations in the first column of Table L1 are those of Section 1 , written down before any judge was run on the graded panels. The six status labels, and the assignment of each expectation to one of them, were decided after the graded panels had been analysed. The evidence column gives the statistic behind each status, and a reader can apply a stricter or a looser rule to it. The binary and graded panels differ in several ways at once (Section 7.3 ), so a status records whether an expectation carried over and does not say which difference decided the outcome.
blocks.zh: 表L1第一栏的预期是第1节的预期,在任何法官被评为分级法官之前写下来。 6个地位标签和对其中1个的期望的分派,是在对分级小组进行分析后决定的。 证据栏给出了每个状态背后的统计数据,读者可以对其适用更严格或宽松的规则. 二进制和分级的面板一次有几种不同(第7.3节),因此状态记录是否延续了期望,没有说明决定结果的是哪种差异.

blocks.en: The release contains the code used to run every judge, the frozen panel samples, and one verdict record per judge and pair. A panel sample holds each unit as the judges received it, the rubric version (criterion sentences and level descriptions), the label, and the individual rater scores behind it. A verdict record holds the judge’s level or verdict, whether it abstained, and any call failure. For Jev it also holds the returned probabilities and confidence, and for the LLM judges the explanation each one returned. The per-panel summaries that the harness wrote, which record cost and wall time, accompany the verdict records.

blocks.en: Two scripts regenerate the paper’s numbers and figures from these files without calling any model. The analysis script computes the values that the paper quotes and writes them to a JSON file and a readable summary, which names for each value the recorded file and key it is read from, or the rule that computes it. The figure script draws every figure from the analysis output alone, at its printed size.
blocks.zh: 两本脚本从这些文件中重新生成纸张的数字和数字,而不叫任何模型. 分析脚本计算纸张引用的值,并将其写到一个JSON文件和一个可读摘要,其中每个值的名称是所记录的文件及其读取的密钥,或者计算它的规则. 图脚本单独从分析输出中抽取每个图,按其印刷大小.

blocks.en: The analysis script checks itself against the recorded results. Its recomputed discordant counts for the 21 graded-panel tests between Jev Choice and the LLM judges and the 7 between Jev Choice and Jev Score, its confidence-band tables for the seven graded panels, and its 21 graded cascade curves all equal the recorded ones. The paired comparisons, group resampling, juries, cross-fitted cascades, and physician reference draw from one fixed seed, with a separate generator for each quantity. The code behind them recomputes pair counts, shares of repeated errors, rater references, oracle-threshold cascades, and physician comparisons, and each equals the value computed without resampling. The ELLIPSE marginal intervals of Appendix C use a seed of their own and one generator shared by the judges.
blocks.zh: 分析脚本对照记录的结果进行自我检查。 其重新计算出的不协调因素计算了Jev Choice和LLM法官之间的21级小组测试,以及Jev Choice和Jev Score之间的7级小组测试,其7级小组的置信带表,以及其21级的级联曲线均等于记录的曲线。 配对比较、组重新取样、陪审团、跨装级联和医生参考从一个固定种子中抽取,每个数量有一个单独的发电机。 后面的代码重算对数,重复误差的股份,推算器参考,甲骨文阈值级联,以及医生的比较,每个值都等于不进行复标计算值. 附录C的ELLIPSE边际间隔使用他们自己的种子和法官共用的一台发电机。

blocks.en: Some values need records other than the panel verdicts and the per-panel summaries.
